story.title: A Mobile Solution to Enhance Engagement for Church Communications
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a React Native mobile app and admin tool for the Assembly of Bishops USA to centralize communication with faith community members.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a React Native mobile app and admin tool for the Assembly of Bishops USA to centralize communication with faith community members.

benefits.title: Enhanced Community Engagement
benefits.description: Increased participation in church initiatives by 40%, with higher feedback response rates through streamlined survey processes.

benefits.title: Improved Security
benefits.description: Robust security measures, including secure authentication and cloud infrastructure, enhance data privacy and trust.

benefits.title: Informed Decision-Making
benefits.description: Data analytics provide actionable insights for church leaders, improving decision-making and responsiveness.

benefits.title: Optimized Administrative Efficiency

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The Assembly of Bishops of the USA faced challenges in efficiently communicating and engaging with the diverse community of faithful members. The lack of a centralized platform for distributing and gathering information hindered the church’s ability to engage effectively and collect valuable feedback.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a cross-platform mobile app for Android and iOS, supported by an Admin Tool to streamline communication and engagement between church leaders and the community.

  • Cross-Platform Mobile App: Built with React Native for seamless functionality on both platforms.
  • Admin Tool: Enables secure user verification, survey management, and push notifications to keep users engaged.
  • Localized Surveys: Customizes surveys for specific regions or demographics to enhance relevance.
  • Push Notifications: Firebase ensures timely updates on new surveys and church initiatives.
  • Security & Scalability: A dedicated Authentication Server and AWS infrastructure ensure data protection and scalability.

Technology Stack

  • React Native
  • Spring Boot
  • Nest JS
  • Angular
  • Docker
  • SQL
  • AWS

story.title: A Next-Gen Document Management Solution: Where Security Meets Collaboration
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a next-gen document management platform with word-level access control, blockchain-backed history, and real-time collaboration.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a next-gen document management platform with word-level access control, blockchain-backed history, and real-time collaboration.

benefits.title: Enhanced Security
benefits.description: Granular access control and tamper-proof records safeguarded sensitive documents.

benefits.title: Streamlined Collaboration
benefits.description: Live co-editing and chat eliminated email-based bottlenecks, improving team productivity.

benefits.title: 40% Efficiency Gain
benefits.description: Automated workflows and notifications reduced processing times for document approvals.

benefits.title: Regulatory Compliance
benefits.description: Immutable change history and activity logs ensured full compliance with audit standards.

benefits.title: Improved User Experience
benefits.description: Scalable architecture supported up to 50 users per document, optimizing large team collaboration.

benefits.title: Market Differentiation
benefits.description: Positioned the client as a leader in secure collaboration, outpacing existing systems like Google Docs.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

In today’s collaborative work environment, organizations face increasing risks when sharing sensitive documents such as legal contracts, government policies, and proprietary designs. Existing platforms lack the granular access control and security required to prevent unauthorized access, leaks, and non-compliance. For large, distributed teams requiring simultaneous collaboration, a solution that integrates robust security with seamless workflows was essential to mitigate these substantial risks.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a secure, scalable, and collaborative document management platform tailored for enhanced security and efficiency. Key Features include:

  • Granular Access Control: Fine-grained permissions down to word level, automated redaction, and time/IP-restricted access ensured data security.
  • Immutable Change History: AWS Blockchain Services provided tamper-proof records of document changes for accountability and compliance.
  • Real-Time Collaboration: Integrated CKEditor for live co-editing with user presence indicators, cursor tracking, and in-app chat.
  • Advanced Security: Auth0 authentication and secure workflows prevented unauthorized actions like copying or printing.
  • Version Control: Full version histories and user activity tracking simplified auditing and document recovery.
  • Seamless Integration: Built on Blitz.js and Prisma for scalable performance and smooth workflows.

Technology Stack

  • Frameworks & Languages: Blitz.js (Node.js), Next.js, TypeScript
  • Database: Prisma
  • Security & Blockchain: AWS Blockchain Services
  • Collaboration Features: CKEditor, Auth0, Novu Notification Service

story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a .NET-based QA automation platform for financial transmission workflows serving 180+ financial institutions and banks.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a .NET-based QA automation platform for financial transmission workflows serving 180+ financial institutions and banks.

benefits.title: Improved Efficiency
benefits.description: Automated handling of diverse file types reduced manual effort, enhancing operational efficiency across 180+ institutions.

benefits.title: Seamless Scalability
benefits.description: Enabled the system to support higher volumes and evolving file formats without performance degradation.

benefits.title: Ensured Compliance
benefits.description: Rigorous testing guaranteed data integrity, meeting regulatory requirements and boosting stakeholder confidence.

benefits.title: Operational Continuity
benefits.description: Phased deployment ensured smooth integration with zero downtime, reinforcing the client’s reliability and commitment to innovation.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A financial services provider managing transmission processes for over 180 financial institutions and banks struggled with manual workflows that were slow, prone to errors, and inefficient. Challenges included handling complex file types (ICLR, ICLM, ICLF), ensuring data integrity across high transmission volumes, and transitioning to an automated system without disrupting operations.

Technology Solution

To address these challenges, a robust web service solution was developed using the .NET framework, focusing on automation, scalability, and reliability:

  • Automated File Handling: Developed precise parsing and processing for file types (ICLR, ICLM, ICLF) to streamline workflows.
  • Testing Automation: Built regression and functional test suites to validate data integrity, ensuring seamless updates and identifying anomalies.
  • Scalable Workflows: Designed modular workflows to handle growing transmission volumes and new file formats efficiently.
  • Phased Deployment: Conducted iterative testing and gradual rollout, ensuring minimal downtime and uninterrupted operations.

Technology Stack

  • Development: .NET Framework
  • Database: SQL Server 2012, SQL Server 2016
  • Testing: Automated regression and functional test suites

story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a scalable B2C Progressive Web App for a fintech startup, enabling automated mutual fund investments, SIP creation, and KYC.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A fintech startup aimed to create a customer-centric investment platform for Android users, offering features like automated investments, SIP creation, and KYC processing. The challenge was to deliver a scalable solution with rapid deployment capabilities while integrating third-party mutual fund APIs to streamline investment workflows.

Technology Solution

We developed a B2C Progressive Web App (PWA) for Android, enabling seamless investment experiences with high scalability and rapid deployment capabilities.

  • Automated Investment Workflows: Implemented dynamic investment engines and SIP creation features to optimize investment processes.
  • Third-Party API Integration: Seamlessly integrated mutual fund APIs to ensure real-time data synchronization and efficient fund management.
  • Progressive Web App (PWA): Built a lightweight PWA using React.js and .NET APIs, eliminating dependency on Play Store releases and enabling instant app updates.
  • Scalable Architecture: Utilized Azure Functions for reliable backend processing and SQL Server for secure data management.

Technology Stack

React.js, ASP.NET MVC, Azure Functions, Web APIs, SQL Server, Service Workers

story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a fully serverless MVP on AWS to digitize the US medical recall process for pharmaceuticals and devices, cutting infrastructure cost.

benefits.title: Cost Efficiency
benefits.description: Achieved up to 70% cost savings with a pay-per-use serverless model and zero infrastructure costs.

benefits.title: Faster Recall Processes
benefits.description: Automated responses reduced processing time by 75% with near-perfect accuracy.

benefits.title: Increased Adoption
benefits.description: Encouraged hospitals to digitize recall workflows, driving business growth and supplier partnerships.

benefits.title: Sustainability
benefits.description: Reduced paper usage and carbon emissions, contributing to environmental sustainability.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The medical recall process in the US for pharmaceuticals and devices remains outdated, relying on paper and snail mail. These inefficient methods waste significant time for healthcare facilities and clinicians, underscoring the need for a true digital solution to automate and streamline recall responses.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an MVP using a fully serverless architecture to minimize costs and ensure scalability. The platform digitizes the recall process for hospitals by enabling electronic submission of recall documents, improving efficiency and traceability.

Key features include:

  • Serverless Model: Cost-efficient and scalable using AWS Lambda for processing and DynamoDB for data management.
  • Secure Storage and Hosting: Amazon S3 for reliable data storage and hosting with secure access.
  • Robust Authentication: Amazon Cognito and Multi-factor Authentication for secure user management.
  • Seamless Adoption: User-friendly design enabled rapid pilot-phase adoption and network effect growth across hospitals and suppliers.

Technology Stack

Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, Amazon Cognito, JavaScript

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Today’s youth struggle to develop essential life skills like perseverance and confidence due to distractions and fragmented learning environments. Educational institutions needed an AI-powered platform to engage students with personalized, interactive content while fostering a supportive, community-driven environment. The platform required real-time synchronization, tailored experiences, and seamless integration with user personas.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a dynamic, AI-powered platform that fosters grit by leveraging advanced technologies and personalized user experiences:

  • Multi-Tenant Architecture: Allowed institutions to operate independently with secure, tenant-based data segregation.
  • AI-Driven Personalization and Analysis: Tailored content and challenges to user personas (e.g., Floater, Achiever) using IBM Bluemix and Clarifai for emotion and sentiment analysis, enhancing engagement and motivation.
  • Interactive Mobile App with Gamification: Built an Android app featuring multimedia creation tools (video editing, audio recording) and gamified elements like leaderboards, rewards, and AI-generated challenges to boost participation.
  • Cost-Effective Processing: Optimized infrastructure costs by 60% through dynamic VM scheduling for on-demand processing.
  • AI Movie Creation: Used MoviePy to create emotion-driven movies with AI-enhanced transitions, music, and effects.

Technology Stack

  • Backend: Node.js, Azure Functions (Serverless Operations)
  • Frontend: Android
  • AI & Machine Learning: Azure Cognitive Services (Text Analytics, Sentiment Analysis), IBM Bluemix (Alchemy), Clarifai (Image & Video Analysis)
  • Media Processing: Python (MoviePy), Open-Source Libraries (AI-driven movie generation)
  • Database: MongoDB
  • Cloud & Notifications: Firebase (Push Notifications & Analytics)

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Small and medium-sized manufacturers face inefficiencies, high costs, and scaling challenges in traditional ERP systems. Our client needed to overhaul their ERP platform to improve reporting, inventory management, work orders, and sales processes while migrating to a scalable cloud infrastructure. The goal was to enhance functionality and prepare the platform as a SaaS offering for other manufacturers and service providers.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts modernized the ERP platform to enhance efficiency, scalability, and functionality:

  • Migrated the system to AWS for scalability, security, and reduced costs.
  • Built cross-module reporting tools for real-time insights across accounting, inventory, and service job costing.
  • Enhanced financial reporting for better cash flow visibility and compliance.
  • Upgraded inventory management for real-time tracking, automation, and improved procurement.
  • Streamlined work orders and service management to reduce delays and optimize resource allocation.
  • Enhanced the sales CRM for lead management, quote generation, and customer satisfaction.
  • Integrated AI-powered analytics and predictive dashboards for improved forecasting and decision-making, along with AI-based task scheduling to optimize machine utilization and operational efficiency.

Technology Stack

  • Web Portal: Angular
  • Web Portal API: .NET Core 7 + ADO.NET + Dapper
  • Database: MySQL
  • Cloud: AWS
  • Automation: Selenium

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Educational institutions faced a challenge in developing an interactive, automated solution capable of generating trivia quizzes from vast data repositories. The goal was to create a dynamic tool to support engaging and customized learning experiences while analyzing student performance effectively.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts created an AI-powered trivia platform that integrates with communication tools like Slack and Microsoft Teams, utilizing advanced NLP and gamification. Key features include:

  • AI-Driven Question Generation: Leveraged Azure Cognitive Services and Wikipedia APIs to extract relevant data and generate multiple-choice questions with accurate distractors using bespoke AI algorithms.
  • Interactive Quiz Bot: Integrated Microsoft BOT Framework for real-time trivia engagement and learning insights.
  • Gamification Elements: Added leaderboards, scoring, and timers to boost user engagement and competition.
  • Scalable AI Infrastructure: Developed a robust database using Azure Table Storage and executed a scalable AI model across virtual machines for reliable performance.
  • Multi-Platform Integration: Enabled seamless functionality across platforms like Slack and Microsoft Teams to enhance accessibility and collaboration.

Technology Stack

  • Azure Cognitive Services (Text Analytics, Sentence Analytics, LUIS)
  • Microsoft BOT Framework
  • React.js, Node.js
  • Azure Table Storage, Wikipedia API
  • Google Cloud Natural Language API

story.title: An Advanced Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) and Invoicing Platform
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built an advanced CLM and invoicing platform for a North American fraud and risk firm, integrated with QuickBooks and Salesforce.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built an advanced CLM and invoicing platform for a North American fraud and risk firm, integrated with QuickBooks and Salesforce.

benefits.title: Data-Driven Decisions
benefits.description: Actionable insights into contract performance and billing trends enabled better strategic planning.

benefits.title: Enhanced Efficiency
benefits.description: Automated workflows improved operational efficiency by 60%, reducing errors and manual intervention.

benefits.title: Scalability
benefits.description: Designed to handle complex contract scenarios and large data sets, supporting future business growth.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A North American Fraud and Risk Management firm faced inefficiencies with manual invoicing processes that were error-prone, time-intensive, and lacked scalability. They required an automated platform to streamline invoicing, align billing with contractual terms, and integrate with financial tools like QuickBooks to support their growing operations.

Technology Solution

We developed an advanced Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) and invoicing platform with integrated analytics and seamless QuickBooks and Salesforce synchronization. Key features include:

  • Comprehensive CLM Tool: Manage contracts with customizable terms, financial minimums, and consolidated invoicing for clarity and compliance.
  • Automated Data Handling: Import historical contract data via templates and support future contract setups to optimize billing workflows.
  • Integrated Financial Systems: QuickBooks integration ensures synchronized client and billing data, while Salesforce automates account updates and production mapping.
  • Customizable Reporting: Generate detailed financial reports, including ARR, billable volumes, unsent invoices, and variance alerts for better decision-making.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Enhanced monthly tracking of usage data, invoice ownership, and storage with capabilities to handle high data volumes.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React.js
  • Backend: Python Flask
  • Storage: AWS S3
  • Integrations: QuickBooks, Salesforce
  • QA Automation: Playwright

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Deploying 5G infrastructure in the fast-evolving telecom industry presents challenges due to the diversity and volume of data involved. Stakeholders with limited technical expertise struggled to consolidate geographic, demographic, and regulatory data, optimize asset deployment, and address real-time planning complexities within regulatory constraints. The absence of a centralized platform hindered data-driven decisions, delayed rollouts, and reduced operational efficiency.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a scalable platform to simplify data integration, optimize 5G deployment, and enable smarter decision-making.

Key Features:

  • User-Centric Design: Intuitive UI/UX tailored for non-technical stakeholders, with interactive wireframes for visualizing complex data.
  • Multi-Format Data Integration: Supported GeoJSON, Shapefiles, XML, CSV, and Excel, leveraging Python algorithms for accurate geolocation insights.
  • Dynamic Visualization Tools: Integrated Mapbox and Leaflet.js for interactive maps, allowing stakeholders to mark areas, analyze data layers, and customize deployment strategies in real time.
  • Scalable and Secure Architecture: Built with ASP.NET Core, Angular, and a Azure-based infrastructure to ensure performance, reliability, and adaptability.
  • Strategic Planning Tools: Enabled scenario simulations for better deployment strategies, empowering smarter and faster decision-making.

Technology Stack

  • Back-End: ASP.NET Core, Python
  • Front-End: Angular
  • Visualization: Mapbox, Leaflet.js
  • Database: PostgreSQL, PostGIS
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Azure DevOps, Azure Elastic Database Pool, Azure Blob Storage, Azure WebJobs

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A fast-growing mobile app development company faced operational disruptions due to the sudden shutdown of a critical platform they relied on for app development and deployment. This led to project delays, dissatisfied customers, and potential revenue loss. The client required an alternative platform that could support seamless migration, provide enhanced customization, and sustain their competitive edge.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts enabled a seamless platform migration and enhanced app development capabilities:

  • Seamless Migration: Transitioned to a CMS platform on AWS EC2, integrating apps from BuildFire without service interruptions.
  • Customization & Flexibility: Introduced custom layouts, CSS features, and tailored designs for faster and user-specific app development.
  • Simplified Development & Publishing: Streamlined workflows for app building and publishing on App Store and Google Play, reducing deployment time.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Utilized AWS EC2 with MySQL for robust, scalable hosting to support growth.
  • Developer-Centric Features: Delivered intuitive workflows and easy source code access for rapid prototyping.

Technology Stack

  • Development Tools: Xcode, Android Studio, Photoshop
  • Hosting: AWS EC2
  • Backend & Database: MySQL, PHP

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading medical communications company faced challenges with complex dashboards that made it difficult for users to quickly access specific data points. As data became more dense and multi-dimensional, users struggled to locate actionable insights, delaying decision-making. The client needed an AI-powered assistant capable of interpreting natural language queries and delivering precise data and visualizations instantly to improve accessibility and responsiveness.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an AI-driven data assistant that simplifies data access and enhances decision-making through advanced analytics. Key features include:

  • Real-Time Data Aggregation: Aggregates data from multiple sources in real time, ensuring the latest, accurate information for decision-making.
  • Natural Language Query Processing: Understands simple English queries, eliminating the need for users to manually navigate complex dashboards.
  • Instant Insights and Visualizations: Provides immediate answers and contextual visualizations, such as charts, directly within the chat interface for better user experience.
  • Seamless Integration: Displays relevant data analytics and charts directly in the chat window, enabling users to interact with the data conversationally.

Technology Stack

  • Text-to-SQL
  • React JS - For chat widget
  • AWS lambda – for query processing

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Law firms handle vast amounts of sensitive legal documentation daily, necessitating efficient cataloging, secure storage, and easy retrieval. Traditional systems often lack the advanced features needed to automate document management, resulting in inefficiencies, security risks, and compliance challenges.

Technology Solution

We developed a secure and intelligent Document Management System (DMS) tailored for legal operations:

  • AI-Driven Search: Automated document classification and keyword search using Azure Cognitive Search.
  • Secure Storage: Azure Blob Storage ensured robust, scalable, and secure document handling.
  • Deep Search Capabilities: Allowed users to locate specific terms within documents for enhanced accessibility.
  • DocuSign Integration: Simplified contract approvals with digital signatures.

Technology Stack

  • Azure Blob Storage
  • Azure Cognitive Search
  • DocuSign
  • .NET Core Web API

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

In Austria, managing tax-saving meal expenses traditionally required manual submission of lunch receipts and data entry, resulting in lost receipts, readability issues, and inefficiencies. This process was time-consuming for employees and HR teams alike. To overcome these challenges, a streamlined solution was needed to simplify and automate meal expense management for improved accuracy and efficiency.

Technology Solution

To address these issues, we developed a comprehensive application with the following key features:

  • A Node.js API for a seamless login system, allowing employees to manage monthly meal budgets easily.
  • Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology to extract invoice details like hotel names, bill items, prices, and taxes from uploaded receipts, improving data accuracy and reducing errors.
  • Firebase for secure data storage and organization, ensuring accessibility for employees and HR teams.
  • An Admin Portal for HR, simplifying onboarding, budget allocation, and customized meal plan creation.
  • Integration with company-issued Lunch Cards, enabling automatic transaction recording, real-time tracking, and enhanced financial transparency.

Technology Stack

  • Flutter
  • Node.js
  • Firebase
  • Magento

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Managing unqualified leads manually led to inefficiencies in tracking, reassignment, and follow-ups, resulting in missed sales opportunities. The client needed an automated, structured approach to categorize and track leads while ensuring timely re-engagement based on business logic. Without automation, sales teams faced delays, reduced productivity, and inconsistent lead handling.

Technology Solution

We integrated Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Queues with Power Automate Flows to streamline lead management, improve reassignment efficiency, and automate follow-up actions.

Key Implementations include -

  • CRM Queues for Lead Management: Designed and automated lead categorization and distribution, reducing manual intervention.
  • Power Automate Flows for Workflow Automation: Configured automatic lead reassignment, follow-up reminders, and status-based task creation.
  • Intelligent Lead Re-Evaluation: Developed automated lead scoring and periodic reassessment to prioritize re-engagement opportunities.
  • Automated Email Notifications & Task Creation: Enabled sales teams to receive alerts for timely lead follow-ups.

Technology Stack

  • CRM: Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Automation: Power Automate

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A global satellite communication leader, operating across 16 offices and managing over 2,000 products across 20+ families, faced challenges with manual quote generation processes. Complex product configurations, time-intensive workflows, and inconsistent quote formats led to delays, errors, and inefficiencies. The lack of automation in generating, storing, and sharing quotes hindered operational scalability and customer satisfaction.

Technology Solution

We implemented an automated quoting system by integrating Dynamics 365 CRM, Power Automate, and PlumSail for dynamic quote generation:

  • Automated Workflow: Triggered by Power Automate, the system processed data from Dynamics 365 into HTML-based templates with dynamic content.
  • PDF Conversion with PlumSail: HTML templates were converted into professionally formatted PDFs with embedded images and multi-currency support.
  • Centralized Document Management: PDFs and editable HTML templates were stored in SharePoint, simplifying updates and retrieval.
  • Customizable Templates: Easily modified for region-specific needs, ensuring consistent branding and compliance.

Technology Stack

  • CRM: Dynamics 365
  • Workflow Automation: Power Automate
  • PDF Conversion: PlumSail
  • Document Management: SharePoint

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A pharma event management company faced challenges with inefficient workflows for task management, budget tracking, and event preparation, causing delays and resource mismanagement. Manual payment processing further complicated financial oversight, while an unresponsive user interface negatively impacted engagement. To remain competitive in the evolving medical communications industry, the client needed a comprehensive digital transformation to streamline operations and enhance user satisfaction.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a modern, scalable platform to address the client’s challenges through an end-to-end overhaul. Key Features include:

  • UI/UX Revamp: Designed an intuitive, responsive interface tailored to user personas, boosting engagement and retention.
  • Tech Stack Modernization: Transitioned to a modern architecture for scalability and performance.
  • Payment Automation: Integrated NetSuite to streamline payment processing, reducing manual errors and enhancing financial accuracy.
  • Budget Management: Introduced a real-time budgeting tool to optimize resource allocation and improve financial oversight.
  • Task Management & Analytics: Centralized task workflows and provided actionable insights via real-time analytics dashboards to improve event outcomes.
  • Dynamic Templating & RSVP Templates: Enabled seamless customization of event materials and branded attendee experiences.
  • Database Redesign: Optimized database performance with faster data retrieval and improved indexing.
  • Integrated Contract Management: Enabled annual contract management with features for signers to input details, digitally sign W9 forms, and finalize contracts via DocuSign. Securely stores signed contracts for payment processing.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: ReactJS, Next.js
  • Backend: Node.js, Nest.js
  • Database: MySQL
  • Analytics & Visuals: GraphQL, Apex Charts
  • Dynamic Templating: CKEditor
  • 3rd Party Integrations: NetSuite (payments), DocuSign (E signature)
  • Cloud Infrastructure: AWS Lambda, AWS Code build, schedule tasks, AWS ECR, AWS ECS, AWS S3, AWS simple email service, AWS SQS, AWS Cognito.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A U.S.-based CX solutions provider faced challenges creating a unified platform due to scattered information and poor integration between their CRM and business applications. This led to data silos, inefficiencies, and limited customer journey visibility. The client needed a robust integration platform for real-time data synchronization, improved efficiency, and actionable insights to ensure consistency and accuracy across systems.

Technology Solution

Our team collaborated with the client to build a scalable SDK and integration platform that ensured real-time synchronization and streamlined data flow across CRM and CX systems.

Key features:

  • Two-Way Synchronization: Flexible data flow in any direction (CX to CRM, CRM to CX, or bidirectional).
  • Configurable Mapping: Granular control over sync direction, field mappings, and custom data.
  • Real-Time Data Sync: Webhooks for instant updates, ensuring data accuracy and reducing delays.
  • Data Tracking: Logged updates (creation, modification, deletion) for streamlined audits and troubleshooting.
  • Built-In CRM Connectors: Prebuilt connectors for Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and ServiceNow.
  • Error Handling and Analytics: Crash reporting and usage analytics to enhance reliability.
  • Scalable Architecture: Microservices-based platform on GCP to handle growing data volumes and future integrations.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: Vue, TypeScript, Storybook
  • Backend: Node.js (Nest JS), MongoDB
  • Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Build, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager)
  • Infrastructure: Terraform
  • Other Tools: OAuth, Jest

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A tech enterprise sought to create a CSR-driven social platform to foster a digital ecosystem where donors and Non-Profits could connect seamlessly. The goal was to automate the matchmaking process, ensuring donations reached the most suitable beneficiaries while maximizing social impact and fostering community engagement.

Technology Solution

We developed an AI-powered platform to transform donor-non-profit connectivity, delivering optimized matches and fostering an interactive, scalable community:

  • AI Matchmaking Marketplace: Advanced algorithms evaluate parameters like location, requirements, transaction history, and feedback to ensure precise donor-NGO matches.
  • Real-Time Interactions: Integrated Firebase Realtime Database enables instantaneous communication, fostering collaboration and decision-making.
  • Transparent Community Features: Social sharing, NGO reviews, and gratitude messages enhance trust and encourage ongoing engagement. Facebook and Google integration simplify user registration while maintaining secure authentication.
  • Agile and Scalable Architecture: Built with Angular and Firebase Cloud Functions, offering responsive interfaces and scalability for high transaction volumes.

Technology Stack

Flutter, Firebase Realtime Database, Google Cloud AI, Angular, Firebase Cloud Functions, WordPress

story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a mass communication platform and mobile app for enterprise emergency response, with mapping, multichannel alerts, and tracking.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a mass communication platform and mobile app for enterprise emergency response, with mapping, multichannel alerts, and tracking.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Enterprises face significant challenges ensuring the safety of employees and nearby residents during emergencies like fires, gas leaks, or severe weather. Traditional, manual safety protocols are prone to human error, risking individual safety and compliance. A fail-safe, automated system was needed to streamline planning, execution, and management of emergency response measures.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts built a robust mass communication platform and mobile app to automate emergency response and enhance operational efficiency.

Key features include:

  • Advanced Mapping Integration: Allows users to delineate emergency areas on Google Maps, overlay additional maps for precise asset identification, and pin key locations like teams, roadblocks, and wind directions.
  • Central Command Center: Azure Web Services deployed as the operational hub to automate and oversee workflows.
  • Multichannel Communication: Email, SMS, chat rooms, and automated voice calls to ensure swift dissemination of critical alerts.
  • Real-Time Tracking and Response Analysis: Monitors individual responses, enabling dynamic adjustments and ensuring accountability.
  • Mobile Data Collection: Flutter-based app collects field data directly into the core web application, eliminating manual import processes and ensuring data accuracy.
  • Automated Escalations: Protocols configured to enhance agility and precision, with templates ensuring consistent messaging.

Technology Stack

  • Backend: ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Azure Functions, Entity Framework
  • Frontend: Angular, Flutter
  • Database: MS SQL Database
  • Cloud & Hosting: Azure Web Services, Azure Web Jobs
  • Mapping & GIS: Google Maps Integration, Leaflet GIS
  • Communication & Automation: Multichannel Alerts (Email, SMS, Chat, Automated Voice Calls)

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading investment advisory firm faced delays in client documentation and workflows, impacting onboarding, decision-making, and productivity. Inefficient processes reduced client satisfaction and hindered competitiveness. The firm needed a secure, scalable platform to streamline document management, enhance communication, and improve client engagement while maintaining compliance.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts delivered a mobile-responsive, client-centric web platform to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency:

  • Advanced Document Management: Integrated DocuSign for seamless digital signatures and ShareFile for centralized, secure file sharing.
  • Enhanced Communication Tools: Real-time chat, web notifications, and calendar synchronization via Nylas improved stakeholder engagement and scheduling.
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Implemented superuser and admin modules to ensure data security and compliance.
  • Third-Party Integration: Embedded Sendbird for advanced communication capabilities, enhancing the platform’s ecosystem.

Technology Stack

• React.js

• Redux

• React Hooks

• Integrations: DocuSign, ShareFile, Nylas, Sendbird

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A Canadian enterprise using Microsoft Dynamics 365 faced inefficiencies in managing contracts, agreements, and approvals. Manual processes caused delays, operational bottlenecks, and increased costs related to physical documentation. A secure, automated, and legally compliant workflow was critical to streamline the contract lifecycle.

Technology Solution

A robust integration of DocuSign with Dynamics 365 was implemented to enhance contract management by automating approvals and signatures. Supported by PowerApps and SharePoint, the solution ensured efficiency and compliance.

  • DocuSign Integration: Automated contract creation and tracking within Dynamics 365, along with pre-configured templates for seamless document workflows.
  • Workflow Automation: Power Automate triggered end-to-end document workflows, reducing manual intervention and ensuring consistent tracking.
  • Centralized Storage: SharePoint integration provided secure document storage and easy retrieval, adhering to compliance standards.

Technology Stack

  • Dynamics 365
  • DocuSign
  • PowerApps
  • Power Automate
  • SharePoint

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A Canadian Satcom provider struggled with fragmented access to service, usage data, invoices, and trouble ticket management. Users faced inefficiencies due to a lack of centralized control over these critical functions.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a comprehensive portal to centralize Satcom management, integrating advanced tools for customer service, asset tracking, and operational efficiency:

  • Centralized Billing & Service Plan Management: Automated invoicing with search and download capabilities allows seamless access to billing history, while users can directly schedule and manage bandwidth plans with automated notifications and dynamic adjustments for events or emergencies.
  • Interactive Asset Monitoring & Usage Analysis: Leveraging Google-Charts and LeafletJS, the portal enables real-time asset tracking with customizable graphs and maps, playback functionality for movement monitoring, and application-based usage insights for better cost and traffic management.
  • Integrated Ticketing & Notifications: The customer support module ensures end-to-end ticket management, while real-time alerts proactively notify users of usage thresholds and service statuses, reducing disruptions.
  • Enhanced Security Features: Comprehensive firewall management, including IP address restrictions and domain filtering, ensures robust data security and compliance.

Technology Stack

  • Angular
  • Spring Boot
  • LeafletJS
  • Google Charts
  • Cypress (Automated Testing)

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The rising popularity of UFC and boxing sparked the need for a specialized social media platform dedicated to these events. The client, an Australian company, required a comprehensive solution that enabled celebrities to issue challenges and allowed fans to actively engage by contributing funds to support these events.

Technology Solution

To address the challenge, we developed an innovative social media platform from scratch with advanced features and technologies:

  • Built a highly scalable and reliable infrastructure leveraging AWS to ensure uptime and performance.
  • Integrated AWS Cloud Front CDN for efficient edge location data access.
  • Utilized MongoDB for scalable management of unstructured data, ensuring seamless growth.
  • Enhanced user engagement with media sharing capabilities, supporting short, portrait-oriented videos and pictures.
  • Implemented Agora.ai for live streaming, enabling real-time fan interactions and event coverage.

Technology Stack

ReactJS, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS ECR, ECS, ELB, S3, Cloud Front, Route53, AWS Cloud Front CDN, Agora.io

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A North American Health & Wellness firm needed a mobile-centric social media platform to inspire wellness among diverse user groups, blending individual health goals with community-driven societal change. The solution had to cater to both public and corporate audiences, fostering engagement while addressing health-focused objectives.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts spearheaded the development of an intuitive mobile application to promote health and community interaction, focusing on:

  • Wellness Pledges: Encouraging users to set health goals and track progress seamlessly.
  • Personal Diaries: Enabling users to document and share wellness journeys via multimedia content for communal inspiration.
  • Dynamic Social Feeds: Highlighting activities and achievements publicly to foster transparency and community support.
  • Engagement Features: Incorporating likes, comments, and sharing for enhanced user interaction and motivation.
  • Group Communities: Providing private and public group functionalities for targeted wellness initiatives and collaborations.
  • Real-Time Messaging: Supporting cohesive interactions through one-on-one and group chats, ensuring an engaging user experience.

Technology Stack

  • Ionic Framework
  • Angular

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The fitness community needed a centralized platform to overcome challenges in virtual interaction, consistent training methodologies, and maintaining connectivity among enthusiasts. A solution was essential to enable seamless engagement, adaptive learning, and dynamic performance tracking.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts created a robust web and mobile fitness coaching platform tailored to enhance virtual training experiences

Mobile App:

  • Built using Flutter, the app enables coaches to manage referral groups, design and share workouts, and provide real-time personalized feedback using gesture recognition.
  • Scalable design ensures smooth handling of high volumes of video and image data.

Web Portal:

  • The "Coach Search Portal" connects athletes with expert coaches via advanced matchmaking features.
  • A Slack-like integrated communication platform fosters collaboration between coaches and athletes.
  • Includes a developmental hub for coaches, promoting knowledge sharing and mentorship.

User-Centric Design:

  • Extensive persona research informed vibrant UI/UX tailored to the needs of fitness enthusiasts, driving engagement and retention.

Technology Stack

  • Languages & Frameworks: Flutter, C# .NET MVC, jQuery
  • Cloud Services: Azure Blob Storage, Firebase, Azure Web Jobs, Azure App Services
  • 3rd Party Integrations: Vimeo, WhatsApp, BrainTree, Twilio

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

An Australian aged care software provider needed to address operational inefficiencies and compliance challenges tied to legacy Windows-based systems. The goal was to modernize applications, including Supplier Agreements and Refund Accommodation Deposits, by migrating to a secure, scalable cloud infrastructure while enhancing functionality and compliance.

Technology Solution

We led a comprehensive cloud migration and enhancement initiative for the aged care software suite, integrating advanced modules and features:

  • Cloud Migration: Migrated critical applications to AWS, leveraging multi-tenant architecture, robust security protocols, and disaster recovery options for scalability and reliability.
  • Refundable Accommodation Deposits (RAD): Automated fee updates, interest calculations, and refund management for financial precision.
  • Supplier Agreements: Centralized supplier data with advanced relationship management, renewal tracking, and compliance monitoring.
  • Resident Agreements and Maintenance: Automated agreement templates, streamlined facility management tasks, and introduced real-time room availability insights.
  • Global Enhancements: Redesigned all screens, introduced DocuSign integration for digital signatures, and simplified claims submission via the Aged Care Provider Portal.
  • Maintenance Register: Built centralized task management and tracking tools with automated reminders for maintenance efficiency.

Technology Stack

.NET Core MVC, React.js, AWS S3, SQL Server, AWS multi-tenant architecture

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

An Austrian software product company distributed employee incentives, like verified offers and coupon codes, via email. However, employees faced challenges locating and applying these coupons, resulting in wasted time and diminished engagement. A unified, seamless solution was required to streamline the rewards experience.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts created a comprehensive Employee Benefits Portal that simplifies rewards access and management while enhancing the employee experience:

  • Coupon Framework: Built a flexible coupon and rewards system serving as virtual currency for transactions.
  • Seamless Brand Integration: Enabled direct integration with brand websites, allowing one-click purchases using the portal.
  • Single Sign-On (SSO): Delivered secure and hassle-free access to all portal features.
  • Personalized Dashboards: Offered employees easy management of points, rewards, and benefits.
  • Mobile-Friendly Design: Ensured accessibility through a mobile-responsive interface.
  • Data Security: Incorporated advanced encryption measures to protect sensitive information.

Technology Stack

  • Flutter
  • Node.js

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

With the rising demand for eco-conscious practices, the hospitality industry faces pressure to adopt sustainable solutions. An American Environmental Services Company, in collaboration with Marriott International, sought to develop a platform that empowers hospitality leaders to make informed, eco-friendly decisions. This initiative aims to align with consumer expectations, enhance reputation, and contribute to environmental health standards.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an Environmental Product Intelligence Portal that aggregates comprehensive environmental data from vendors and provides tools for informed, sustainable decision-making.

Key features include:

  • Vendor Evaluation: Dynamic rating system categorizing vendors as starters, leaders, or achievers for eco-conscious product selection.
  • Designer Empowerment: Tools to upload and showcase sustainable projects, including detailed environmental impact evaluations.
  • Advanced Analytics: Apex Charts for interactive, visual insights to replace static Tableau reports, improving user engagement.
  • Role-Based Access: Secure, tailored access for designers, vendors, and administrators.

story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a lean CRM with real-time KPI tracking and alerts, integrated with NetSuite, SAP, and Microsoft Dynamics for field sales teams.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Conventional CRM systems are often too rigid and inefficient for dynamic field sales operations. These systems lack features that effectively support sales representatives and managers in real-time. The client required a user-friendly platform to streamline field sales processes, provide instant access to essential data, and enable better decision-making on the go.

Technology Solution

To optimize field sales operations, we developed a user-friendly lean CRM solution with:

  • Sales Tools: Features for forecasting, opportunity tracking, activity logging, and goal monitoring.
  • Management Support: Real-time reporting, KPI tracking, and target setting to align sales goals.
  • Real-Time Alerts: Notifications for sales milestones and commission updates.
  • Integration: Seamless connectivity with CRMs like NetSuite, SAP, and Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Secure Design: JWT authentication, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and Hangfire for task management.
  • Actionable Insights: Advanced analytics and a dashboard for real-time sales and customer performance data.

Technology Stack

ASP.Net Core 6.0, Vue.js with Vuetify, SQL Server on Azure, CSS, Bitbucket, JIRA, Hangfire, RBAC, Azure SQL, JWT, .NET Identity, Web API, Entity Framework Core

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A North American enterprise sought to empower restaurateurs to optimize their unique selling proposition—service quality—through data analytics. Restaurant owners needed a solution to measure and improve staff performance, track service metrics, and directly link operational excellence to revenue growth.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a comprehensive data analytics platform that transforms service quality metrics into actionable insights, helping restaurant owners elevate customer experiences and profitability.

  • Data Aggregation: Integrated diverse sources, such as Dropbox, into an Azure-based data warehouse for centralized analysis.
  • Advanced Analytics: Processed service speed, table management, and staff engagement metrics using sophisticated data mining algorithms.
  • Dynamic Data Visualization: Used Chart.JS and ApexCharts for intuitive, cost-effective visualization of performance metrics, enabling owners to monitor KPIs and identify areas for improvement.

Technology Stack

ASP.NET MVC, MS SQL Server, Chart.JS, Azure Functions, Entity Framework, ApexCharts

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

In a competitive retail environment, ensuring optimal product placement across vast networks is essential but labor-intensive. A leading beverage manufacturer needed an automated solution to align in-store execution with marketing strategies, reducing errors and manual efforts.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts designed a robust integration framework, connecting the brand's CRM and marketing systems with a retail analytics platform for seamless data handling and actionable insights:

  • API-Driven Architecture: Enabled real-time data interchange between systems, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
  • Azure Blob Storage: Provided scalable, secure data storage for strategic marketing datasets, ensuring swift retrieval and processing.
  • Azure Functions and Translation Engine: Automated data conversion to analytics-ready formats, enhancing utility and accessibility.
  • Azure Storage Queues: Managed high data request volumes, maintaining performance and responsiveness for continuous retail evaluation.

Technology Stack

  • Languages & Frameworks: C#
  • Cloud Services: Azure Blob Storage, Azure Functions, Azure Storage Queues
  • Database: SQL

story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a Next.js and AWS energy comparison platform for Texas, delivering personalized plan recommendations with cost analysis.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a Next.js and AWS energy comparison platform for Texas, delivering personalized plan recommendations with cost analysis.

benefits.description: Graphical data visualization and responsive design boosted user interaction and satisfaction.

benefits.description: Achieved a 30% reduction in page load times, ensuring smooth experiences during peak traffic.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Decentralized power availability in Texas made comparing energy plans challenging for customers. The existing platform struggled with performance, responsiveness, and discoverability. To address these limitations, the client needed a scalable, high-performing platform that simplifies the energy selection process while delivering actionable insights and a superior user experience.

Technology Solution

We built a scalable energy comparison platform using Next.js and AWS to deliver personalized, responsive, and high-performing energy recommendations. Key highlights include:

  • Tailored Energy Plans: Collected user inputs (energy usage, contract preferences) for personalized plan recommendations with rich visual insights like cost breakdowns and renewable energy contributions.
  • Fast, Dynamic Performance: Implemented static site generation (SSG), server-side rendering (SSR), and caching to optimize page load speeds and provide real-time updates.
  • SEO Enhancements: Improved search visibility with pre-rendering, structured metadata, and schema markup for increased platform discoverability.
  • Scalable Development & Hosting: AWS cloud infrastructure, Amazon MySQL RDS, and DynamoDB support future growth, while streamlined file-based routing and API management facilitate ongoing development efficiency.

Technology Stack

Next.js, SCSS, AWS (Amazon MySQL RDS, DynamoDB), GitHub, Jira

Business Problem

A Canadian horticulture company specializing in high-quality flower bulbs faced operational inefficiencies due to an outdated web system. Challenges included errors in order processing, inventory management, invoicing, and labeling, which hindered their ability to scale operations effectively.

Technology Solution

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A compliance-focused client required an upgrade from SQL Server 2012 to 2016 to meet PCI DSS standards. With over 600 database objects, including stored procedures, views, and triggers, the upgrade posed significant challenges in ensuring compatibility, data integrity, and seamless integration with existing applications without disrupting functionality.

Technology Solution

We implemented a comprehensive and phased testing strategy to validate the SQL Server upgrade:

  • Database Object Validation: Prioritized and tested over 600 database objects to ensure compatibility and error-free execution on SQL Server 2016.
  • Data Consistency Checks: Verified data correctness by comparing outputs across SQL Server versions for identical results.
  • Application Integration Testing: Conducted end-to-end testing to ensure upgraded databases seamlessly integrated with the client’s applications.
  • Phased Deployment: Minimized risks through iterative validation in live environments, allowing for controlled rollouts and adjustments.

Technology Stack

  • Database Platforms: SQL Server 2012, SQL Server 2016
  • Testing Tools: Query analyzers and application testing frameworks

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

In the fast-paced modern world, a Dutch enterprise recognized the pressing need for an intuitive tool to help individuals monitor their mental health remotely and identify the need for timely intervention. The goal was to provide an accessible, efficient platform that simplified psychological self-assessment and connected users with appropriate resources.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts designed a user-friendly web-based Mental Health Questionnaire platform, delivering detailed insights into users' psychological well-being through:

  • Interactive Wellness Assessment: Focused, theme-based questions that offer clarity on mental health status.
  • Advanced Algorithmic Analysis: Evaluation of responses across eight distinct psychological dimensions to detect signs of distress or disorders.
  • Tailored Recommendations: Suggested pathways for self-care, group sessions, or one-on-one mental health professional consultations with integrated appointment scheduling.
  • Graphical Results Representation: Intuitive visualizations simplify understanding of survey outcomes for users.
  • Historical Data Tracking: Enables users to monitor mental health trends over time, supporting continuous improvement and intervention planning.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React.js
  • Backend: ASP.NET Core
  • Cloud Services: Azure
  • Database: SQL
  • Development Tools: Azure DevOps

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The bond market's reliance on manual workflows creates inefficiencies, limits client engagement, and restricts access to real-time analytics. These challenges hinder operational agility, transparency, and decision-making, necessitating a modern, technology-driven platform to optimize trading processes and reduce costs.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a state-of-the-art bond trading platform to enhance operational efficiency, client engagement, and market analytics.

Key Features:

  • Real-Time Market Updates: Utilized Socket.io and Stomp.js for live market insights, ensuring traders stay informed.
  • BWIC Automation: Standardized and automated BWIC list management for improved transparency and participation.
  • Optimized Bid Management: Streamlined workflows for bid creation, submission, and negotiation.
  • Enhanced Client Engagement: Integrated chat tools and personalized recommendations to foster collaboration.
  • Straight-Through Processing (STP): Enabled end-to-end trade processing with external platform compatibility.
  • Scalable Deployment: Hosted on AWS S3 for reliability, scalability, and seamless performance.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: JavaScript (React.js), XML
  • Real-Time Communication: Socket.io, Stomp.js
  • Hosting: AWS S3

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A major U.S. pharma company with over 300,000 employees globally faced challenges in implementing and monitoring its Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB) model. The vast workforce made it difficult to identify improvement areas, determine suitable initiatives, and effectively schedule programs. The company needed a scalable, streamlined solution to track DEIB efforts and ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed easy-to-use Analytical and Statistical Quarterly Business Review (QBR) dashboards to monitor and advance DEIB initiatives. Key contributions included:

  • Collecting and consolidating data for dashboard inputs.
  • Conducting detailed analyses of existing DEIB reports for actionable insights.
  • Documenting processes for mandatory DEIB reporting to meet U.S. government standards.
  • Automating data collation to streamline future QBR dashboard updates, improving accuracy and efficiency.

Technology Stack

  • MS Office (Excel)
  • Tableau

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A provider of workplace safety and compliance solutions aimed to modernize their decentralized system by migrating to a centralized database and transitioning the frontend from Xamarin to .NET for better scalability and maintainability. The client faced challenges in ensuring data accuracy during the database migration, validating the new .NET-based frontend, and maintaining system stability under peak user loads.

Technology Solution

We implemented comprehensive QA strategies to address these challenges:

  • Automated Regression Testing: Developed automated test suites to validate core functionality and accelerate defect identification.
  • UI and Data Validation: Conducted in-depth UI testing for a seamless user experience and SQL-based validation to ensure data integrity post-migration.
  • Frontend Migration Testing: Extensive regression testing ensured consistent performance and functionality during the transition to .NET.
  • Performance Testing: Simulated real-world scenarios with JMeter to validate scalability and stability under peak user loads.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend Validation: .NET
  • Database Migration: SQL
  • QA Automation: Selenium, Cypress
  • Performance Testing: JMeter

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading global car rental company managing a vast fleet across thousands of locations faced challenges in ensuring seamless operation and maintenance of its ticket management portal. The portal, critical for managing high volumes of maintenance requests, required rigorous quality assurance to prevent disruptions, maintain operational accuracy, and enhance customer satisfaction.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts conducted comprehensive manual quality assurance testing to ensure the maintenance portal met the client’s performance and reliability expectations:

  • API Validation: Thorough API testing ensured the backend processes accurately synchronized ticket statuses, enhancing operational transparency and reducing errors.
  • Notification Testing: Verified the accuracy and timeliness of email and system notifications to provide reliable service updates to customers and staff.
  • User Interface (UI) Assurance: Conducted detailed UI testing to ensure an intuitive and error-free experience for users interacting with the portal.
  • Database Integrity Checks: Ensured data consistency and accuracy through robust database testing, preserving the integrity of service records and analytics.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A global pharmaceutical company faced inefficiencies in its manual reimbursement process for event speakers, leading to delays, frequent errors, and a lack of transparency. Adhering to financial regulations while managing administrative overhead and ensuring speaker satisfaction posed significant challenges.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts delivered a tailored web application to automate and optimize reimbursement workflows:

  • Automated Approvals: Configured two-level approval workflows with real-time notifications for speakers and admins.
  • Real-Time Alerts: Integrated Amazon SES for instant notifications at every stage of the reimbursement process.
  • Data Security: Secured sensitive information with field-level encryption, signed URLs for file storage, and AWS Cognito for robust access control.
  • Optimized Workflows: Reduced manual administrative efforts by 70%, ensuring quicker processing and improved operational efficiency.
  • Scalable Hosting: Hosted on AWS, providing high performance, reliability, and scalability to meet business demands.

Technology Stack

React, TypeScript, Node.js, AWS (Cognito, SES, S3), MySQL RDS

story.title: From Chaos to Clarity: Reimagining Enterprise Knowledge with an AI Assistant
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built an AI knowledge assistant for a US financial services firm, using Copilot Studio and SharePoint to unlock 100+ hours of video.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built an AI knowledge assistant for a US financial services firm, using Copilot Studio and SharePoint to unlock 100+ hours of video.

benefits.description: Employees now find information within seconds, saving hundreds of productive hours each month.

benefits.title: Faster Onboarding
benefits.description: Easy access to training resources reduced new hire onboarding time by 25%, accelerating integration and upskilling.

benefits.title: Cost Savings
benefits.description: By minimizing time spent on non-productive tasks, employees focus more on value-driven work, achieving significant cost savings.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Employees in a fast-paced enterprise often struggle to access essential information buried in 100+ hours of training videos, lengthy transcripts, and scattered documents. This challenge leads to wasted time, workflow disruptions, and knowledge-sharing bottlenecks, impacting productivity and engagement. Recognizing this issue, an American financial services company sought a solution to simplify access to critical information and streamline knowledge transfer.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an AI-Powered Knowledge Management Assistant to revolutionize information access and efficiency. Key components of the solution include:

  • Transcript and Data Preparation: Generated structured transcripts from training videos stored in the SharePoint library to form the assistant’s knowledge base.
  • Automated Summarization: Used Microsoft AI Builder to generate concise summaries, allowing users to retrieve key insights without combing through lengthy content.
  • AI-Powered Assistant: Built using Microsoft Copilot Studio, the assistant provides real-time, context-aware answers by accessing transcripts, summaries, and video content.
  • Seamless Integration: Embedded the assistant into a new SharePoint page, offering employees a centralized and intuitive interface for instant information retrieval.

Technology Stack

  • Microsoft SharePoint
  • Microsoft Copilot Studio
  • Microsoft Power Automate
  • Microsoft AI Builder
  • Microsoft Azure App Registration

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Healthcare professionals must stay updated with evolving medical guidelines, yet traditional educational platforms often lack engagement and fail to cater to diverse learning needs. A leading biopharmaceutical organization struggled with static, non-interactive platforms that limited user participation and tracking of learning outcomes. They sought an innovative solution to deliver engaging, scalable, and outcome-driven medical education.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a responsive, gamified learning platform designed to transform medical education for healthcare professionals. Key Features:

  • Interactive Video-Based Learning: Delivered case studies through hosted videos with an OTT-style interface for seamless, engaging experiences.
  • Gamification and Quizzes: Embedded quizzes tied to case studies, coupled with gamified elements like scoreboards and learning credits to foster competition and sustained engagement.
  • Advanced Analytics: Used Google Tag Manager to track user behavior, enabling data-driven content optimization and engagement strategies.
  • Responsive PWA Architecture: Built on Azure PaaS with Blazor WebAssembly for scalable, offline-capable, and responsive performance during high traffic.
  • Administrative Portal: Enabled efficient content and user management through a dedicated backend portal.

Technology Stack

  • Frameworks: ASP.NET MVC, .NET Core, Blazor WebAssembly
  • Front-End: jQuery, Bootstrap, CSS, PWA
  • Hosting: Azure PaaS
  • Data Management: Azure SQL
  • Video Hosting: Vimeo
  • Email Integration: SendGrid

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Identifying and managing risks across diverse departments and global locations is a critical challenge for large-scale enterprises. To address this, a Big Four consultancy sought to develop an Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) platform to streamline risk strategies and provide standardized solutions.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a cloud-hosted, multi-tenant Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) platform for medium and large organizations, ensuring comprehensive risk visibility and management. Key features include:

  • Risk Cataloguing and Evaluation: Centralized logging, policy application, streamlined audits, quantification, and scheduling.
  • Risk Response: Clear responsibility allocation and actionable risk response strategies.
  • Risk Surveillance: Dynamic dashboards, automated reminders, and audits for continuous risk monitoring.
  • Analytical Insights: Metrics for analyzing risk profiles, exposures, and hotspots.

Interactive dashboards deliver critical metrics, while structured workflows ensure consistency. Designed with a responsive Bootstrap UI, the platform integrates WebJobs for backend processing and custom email notifications for seamless communication.

Technology Stack

.NET MVC, Azure, Azure SQL, WebJobs, ApexCharts.JS, Charts.JS, SQL Server, HTML, CSS, jQuery, AJAX, SendGrid

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A Canadian company sought to redefine residential lighting with smart technology, empowering users to remotely control and customize lighting ambiance. They required an intuitive application to integrate smart lighting devices, ensuring seamless and adaptive user experiences.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts built a holistic solution combining mobile and web applications to manage IoT-enabled lighting systems:

Mobile App:

  • Developed with Flutter for cross-platform compatibility, offering real-time control over lighting fixtures.
  • Integrated rich customization options, including colors, patterns, and intensities, for tailored lighting scenarios.
  • Advanced scheduling features enable automated lighting based on routines or special occasions.

IoT Integration:

  • Used MQTT protocol with AWS IoT Core for real-time, bi-directional communication between users and devices.

Web Portal:

  • Built on .NET 5, the portal provides administrative controls, data analytics, and tools for energy optimization and predictive maintenance.

Technology Stack

  • Languages & Frameworks: Flutter, .NET 5
  • Cloud Services: AWS IoT Core, MQTT Protocol, Firebase Authentication
  • Database: MongoDB
  • Other Tools: Material Design, Hangfire Scheduled Jobs

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Law firms face challenges in managing complex workflows and accurately tracking billable hours. These challenges, coupled with the multi-tenant architecture of an ERP system and a globally distributed team, demanded an advanced QA automation strategy to ensure thorough validation, reliability, and performance across tenants.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts implemented a robust QA automation framework tailored for a multi-tenant ERP, addressing critical challenges and ensuring efficient testing:

  • Comprehensive Testing Approach: Designed environment-specific protocols for QA, staging, and UAT, alongside role-based access and tenant-specific validations, ensuring feature accuracy and security compliance.
  • Dynamic Test Data Management: Streamlined data handling with configuration properties and structured Excel workbooks to match environment requirements and improve accuracy.
  • Automated Test Pipeline: Leveraged Jenkins for executing configurable tests across environments, browsers, and test suites, enhancing coverage and reducing manual efforts.
  • Framework Maintenance and Reporting: Iteratively improved the framework using sprint retrospectives while delivering detailed reports with validations, screenshots, and actionable insights for stakeholders.
  • Test Case Management: Standardized test case naming, tracking, and reporting to ensure thorough requirement coverage and alignment with the release lifecycle.

Technology Stack

Java, Selenium Web Driver, TestNG, Maven, Jenkins, Git and GitHub, Extent Reports, Test Rail - Jira

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The client, a leading sales solutions provider, faced significant challenges in ensuring the quality and scalability of their Sales Performance Management platform. Key issues included lengthy manual regression cycles, limited test coverage, inefficient data validation for complex analytics, and cumbersome access control testing. Additionally, external CRM integrations with platforms like NetSuite and SAP added complexity, while inefficient feedback loops delayed real-world scenario validation.

Technology Solution

To address these challenges, a robust QA automation and test management framework was implemented:

  • Regression Automation: Developed reusable scripts to cut regression cycle times by 50%.
  • Centralized Test Management: Integrated the Vyansa Jira plug-in to organize test cases and attached detailed video evidence to improve documentation and communication.
  • Dynamic Data Validation: A custom query engine ensured the accuracy of analytics and dashboards.
  • Secure Access Controls: Automated JWT authentication and RBAC testing simulated multi-role environments to ensure compliance and security.
  • API Integration Testing: Comprehensive API tests validated seamless synchronization with third-party systems.
  • Collaborative Feedback Loops: Collaborated with the client’s team for defect validation, backlog refinement, and streamlined reporting.
  • Continuous Testing with CI/CD: Integrated Jenkins-based pipelines for continuous regression and performance testing.
  • Automated Reporting: Provided actionable insights via automated reports to expedite issue resolution.

Technology Stack

  • Test Management: Vyansa Jira plug-in
  • Automation: Jenkins for CI/CD pipelines
  • API Testing: Postman, Newman
  • Dynamic Validation: Custom query engine
  • Testing Protocols: JWT validation, RBAC simulation

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading US-based tech firm aimed to revolutionize medical education within hospitals through a mobile quiz app, offering healthcare professionals an engaging platform to refresh and test their medical knowledge. The objective was to refresh and enhance medical knowledge through an interactive, enjoyable learning experience.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an advanced mobile application and web-based admin portal tailored for gamified medical education. Key features include:

  • Quiz Access & Content Management: Instant availability of medical quizzes across specialties, with admin tools for curating and updating content.
  • Interactive Challenges & Gamification: Real-time peer battles, scoring, leaderboards, and badges to enhance engagement and collaboration.
  • Live Quiz Events: Simulated tournaments for communal learning experiences.
  • Real-Time Updates: Firebase integration for dynamic score updates and user performance tracking.
  • Admin Portal & Customization: Web-based admin portal for user management, content updates, and white-labeling to align with hospital branding.

Technology Stack

Flutter, Firebase, .NET Core API, SQL, .NET Core (web portal), Azure

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

High-risk industries like mining face challenges in ensuring employee safety and meeting regulatory compliance due to manual, error-prone processes for incident reporting and inspections. Delays in generating compliant reports and managing complex workflows increase inefficiencies and risks. The client required an automated, scalable solution to centralize safety management, improve operational efficiency, and ensure compliance.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a centralized safety management platform with automation and offline capabilities to streamline compliance and operations. Key Features:

  • Unified Architecture: Monolithic design consolidated tenant data for scalability and efficiency.
  • Automated Workflows: Included programmatic tenant onboarding, configurable modules, and pro-rated invoicing to streamline operations.
  • Offline Functionality: Mobile app enabled incident logging and reporting without network connectivity.
  • Real-Time Notifications: Azure Functions and Service Bus ensured timely alerts via email, SMS, and push notifications.
  • Robust Security: Multi-level authentication and data encryption ensured secure operations and access control.

Technology Stack

  • Core Technologies: ASP.NET MVC, Xamarin Forms, SQL Server
  • Cloud Services: Azure Functions, Azure Web Jobs
  • Third-Party Integrations: SendGrid, Twilio, Firebase, Braintree

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A Canadian IT Emergency Services firm faced fragmented workflows as employees toggled between MS Teams and external browsers to access internal web applications. This inefficiency disrupted collaboration and productivity, necessitating a seamless in-app integration solution to centralize operations within MS Teams.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an advanced integration framework to unify access to web applications within the Microsoft Teams environment. Key features included:

  • Custom Tabs: Enabled direct access to essential web applications from within MS Teams.
  • Application Integration: Imported app packages into MS Teams to integrate new and existing applications seamlessly.
  • Security Configuration: Registered applications with Azure Active Directory for enhanced security and user management.
  • Single Sign-On (SSO): Deployed Azure Active Directory for unified authentication, linking MS Teams accounts to web applications for streamlined access.

Technology Stack

  • MS Teams
  • Azure (Active Directory)
  • Angular

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Industrial sectors dependent on heavy machinery struggle with dispersed asset management, resulting in high downtime, costly maintenance, and reduced productivity. Limited real-time insights into asset performance and location exacerbate operational inefficiencies. The client required a scalable IoT-enabled solution to track and monitor assets in real-time, predict and prevent maintenance issues, and provide actionable insights for asset utilization and operational optimization.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts delivered a robust IoT-enabled asset management platform, integrating advanced technology to enhance visibility and operational efficiency.

Key Features:

  • Real-Time Asset Tracking: Integrated GPS with Google Maps and Leaflet.js for precise location monitoring.
  • Dynamic Mapping: Visual overlays for weather data, fire hazards, wind conditions, and cloud coverage to aid decision-making.
  • Self-Service Portal: Drag-and-drop interface to create custom workflows, jobs, and alerts.
  • Rule-Based Alerts: Automated notifications triggered by configurable parameters for real-time responsiveness.
  • Scalable Serverless Architecture with Secure Access: Built on AWS API Gateway, Lambda Functions, and WebSocket for real-time updates and seamless processing, with Single Sign-On (SSO) ensuring simplified and secure user authentication.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: Angular
  • Backend: Node.js
  • Database: PostgreSQL
  • Maps Integration: Google Maps, Leaflet.js
  • Cloud Services: AWS (API Gateway, Lambda Functions, Serverless Framework)
  • Real-Time Communication: WebSocket

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The International Body for Conservation of Nature (IBCN) faced challenges with the outdated African Elephant Database (AED), including:

  • Obsolete Technology: Legacy Ruby on Rails framework limited system performance.
  • Inefficient Data Management: Poor data retrieval, integrity issues, and lack of comprehensive documentation.
  • Limited Predictive Insights: No AI-driven capabilities for proactive conservation planning.

Technology Solution

  • System Overhaul & Documentation: Conducted a full system analysis to define architecture improvements and document key processes.
  • Database Modernization: Optimized storage and retrieval processes using AWS RDS with PostgreSQL.
  • AI-Powered Predictive Analytics: Integrated Amazon SageMaker to analyze population trends, poaching risks, and habitat threats.
  • User-Centric Interfaces: Developed intuitive UIs for faster, more accurate data entry and visualization.
  • Cloud-Based Scalability: Migrated to a modern AWS-based infrastructure for flexibility, security, and performance.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React (TypeScript), AWS CloudFront, S3 Hosting
  • Backend: AWS API Gateway, AWS Lambda (Node.js), AWS Cognito, AWS Fargate
  • Database & Storage: AWS RDS (PostgreSQL), S3 for logs & shapefiles
  • AI & Data Services: Amazon SageMaker
