story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A medical communications company conducting 200+ training sessions monthly sought an automated solution to improve speaker assessment, sentiment analysis, and compliance monitoring. Manual evaluation methods were time-consuming, subjective, and inconsistent, making it difficult to maintain quality and adhere to regulatory standards across events. The company needed a data-driven AI solution to objectively evaluate speaker performance, analyze sentiment, and ensure compliance while improving session outcomes.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an AI-powered application that automates speaker evaluation, sentiment analysis, and compliance monitoring using advanced AI services. Key features include:

  • Speaker & Sentiment Analysis: Detects individual speakers, analyzes sentiment trends, and evaluates engagement through metrics like speaking time and sentiment shifts.
  • Acoustic Analysis: Examines tone, pitch, speed, and pauses at 10-second intervals to assess vocal delivery and emotional impact, providing insights into speaker effectiveness.
  • Compliance Monitoring: Evaluates session transcripts for adherence to federal regulations, generating compliance scores to reduce risks.
  • AI-Generated Summaries & Quizzes: Creates automated session summaries and quizzes based on transcripts to reinforce learning outcomes and gauge audience engagement.

Technology Stack

  • AI Services: AWS Comprehend (sentiment analysis), AWS Transcribe (speech-to-text), OpenAI (ChatGPT for summarization and quizzes)
  • Acoustic Analysis: Vokaturi, Librosa, NumPy
  • Infrastructure: AWS S3 (file hosting), Lambda (processing)

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A medical communications company serving global pharmaceutical firms sought to improve program planning and evaluation through data-driven insights. The client faced challenges including limited visibility into program effectiveness, cumbersome data handling from legacy systems, and inefficient manual data exploration, all of which hindered timely decision-making and resource allocation.

Technology Solution

To address these challenges, we developed a scalable and intuitive Analytical Dashboard with advanced visualizations and features:

  • Data Integration with ETL: Implemented an ETL process to cleanse and integrate data from legacy systems into an OLAP database, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  • Interactive Filtering and Drill-Downs: Provided robust filters and dynamic drill-down options for in-depth exploration across metrics like year, region, program type, and brand.
  • Advanced Visualizations: Created dynamic charts and graphs to track attendance trends, budget utilization, and compliance metrics, offering real-time insights.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Designed a responsive, easy-to-navigate dashboard using React.js to cater to users with varying technical expertise.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React.js
  • Backend: Express.js and MySQL
  • Visualization: ApexCharts

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A US-based wood stove manufacturer sought to integrate smart technology into their stoves, enabling remote management and promoting eco-friendly practices. The client needed a reliable mobile application to manage the stoves, offering real-time guidance and seamless IoT integration. Key challenges included managing dynamic regression testing, ensuring app stability under peak usage, and validating real-time IoT data accuracy across diverse conditions.

Technology Solution

To ensure app reliability and efficiency, we implemented advanced QA strategies:

  • Automated Regression Testing: Transitioned to Cypress for faster execution and automated critical scenarios to identify defects early.
  • Performance Testing: Simulated real-world usage with JMeter, validating stability under peak loads of up to 100 concurrent users.
  • Iterative Testing: Combined automated and manual end-to-end testing to validate IoT functionality, data accuracy, and user experience.
  • Comprehensive Release Cycles: Automated test suites executed with every release ensured consistent quality and seamless integration with IoT devices.

Technology Stack

  • QA Automation Frameworks: Cypress, Selenium
  • Performance Testing: JMeter
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Firebase Cloud Functions

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The client, a boutique property finance brokerage, faced challenges with their third-party CRM, including:

  • Low User Adoption: Lack of engagement due to poor access management and inefficient email tracking.
  • Integration Failures: Data inconsistencies due to third-party CRM webhook issues.
  • Security Gaps: Improper access roles and inadequate data privacy measures.
  • Customization Issues: Ineffective system modifications impacting business processes.

Technology Solution

  • Fixing User Adoption Issues: Improved RBAC access, optimized email configurations, and enforced business rules for data accuracy.
  • Seamless CRM Integration: Used Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, and plug-ins to eliminate duplicate records and synchronize data.
  • Enhanced Security: Implemented role-based access, secured Outlook/Teams integrations, and optimized configurations.
  • Advanced Loan Management Features: Developed 360-degree client financial views, cross-collateral loan linking, and commercial credit memo syncing.
  • Boosting Throughput with Power Platform & Azure: Leveraged PCF components for dynamic UI, Power Automate for workflow automation, and Azure Functions for rapid document generation.

Technology Stack

  • CRM: MS Dynamics 365 (Sales Module)
  • Languages & Frameworks: C#, JavaScript, PCF Components
  • Cloud Services: Azure Logic App, Azure Functions
  • Automation: Power Automate Flows
  • Reporting Tools: SSRS

story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a lightweight, API-driven license management system for a Swedish gene expression analytics platform, using JWT and Azure Functions.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a lightweight, API-driven license management system for a Swedish gene expression analytics platform, using JWT and Azure Functions.

benefits.title: Simplified User Management
benefits.description: Streamlined handling of subscription plans and user access for the core application.

benefits.title: Enhanced Data Privacy
benefits.description: Robust authentication prevents unauthorized access, ensuring data security.

benefits.description: Easy module-level access management for administrators.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A Swedish company needed a better way to manage users of its multi-dimensional data analysis platform for gene expression profiling and spectroscopic data analysis. The product offered three subscription tiers and required robust user access management based on the subscription level.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a lightweight, API-enabled License Management system to seamlessly integrate with the core platform. Key features include:

  • Subscription Management: Enables creation of users and subscription plans (Trial, Basic, Advanced).
  • Module-Level Access: Admins can assign access based on subscription tier and module requirements.
  • Authentication via JWT: Ensures secure user authentication using JWT tokens generated by the License Management system.
  • Lean API Layer: REST APIs authenticate users at login and manage access tokens, all hosted on Azure Functions.
  • Automation Tested: APIs validated using Rest Assured for reliability and security.

Technology Stack

.NET MVC, Node js

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading medical communications and event management company faced challenges modernizing its decade-old web portal while preserving 15 years of critical historical data. The outdated system lacked scalability and modern features, leading to inefficiencies, and posed significant risks during data migration due to its operational importance. The new platform needed to support growth, ensure data accuracy, and avoid disruptions.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts implemented a comprehensive modernization solution that ensured data integrity and operational continuity:

  • Modern Relational Database Design: Built an ACID-compliant database to manage large data volumes, ensuring data consistency and scalability.
  • Automated Data Migration: Developed a Node.js-powered migration framework with schema mapping, custom field transformations, and data structuring for seamless migration.
  • Cloud-Based Scalability: Hosted the new platform on AWS, enabling robust performance and future growth.
  • Security Integration: Implemented advanced measures to protect sensitive customer data during migration.

Technology Stack

  • Backend: Node.js
  • Database: Relational Database Management System
  • Cloud Hosting: AWS

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading SaaS-based CMMS provider with over 100,000 users across 3,500 organizations globally sought to modernize their legacy platform. They aimed to deliver enhanced user experiences, streamline operations, and maintain their competitive edge in the CMMS market by integrating advanced technologies, improving security, and enabling seamless interoperability with third-party systems.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts modernized the CMMS platform with advanced integrations, enhanced security, and improved scalability:

  • User Migration & Identity Management: Transitioned 100k+ users to a secure .NET Identity framework with Azure AD for better authentication and compliance.
  • Custom API Development: Built 80+ APIs with secure JWT authentication to enable seamless integrations with ERP, CRM, and financial systems.
  • Dynamic Mapping Integration: Integrated Here Maps and OpenStreetMap with custom markers to visualize work orders and asset locations.
  • QuickBooks Automation: Automated financial workflows using Zapier, reducing manual effort.
  • Enhanced Data Handling: Built a parallel database for real-time data access and enabled scheduled data exports to external storage solutions like Google Drive and SFTP.

Technology Stack

  • Frameworks: ASP.NET MVC, MySQL
  • Integrations: Here Maps, Zapier (QuickBooks), OpenStreetMap
  • Security: JWT Authentication, Azure AD
  • Mapping Tools: DevExpress, Leaflet

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

An outdated Mosaic-based payment platform created challenges for the client, including high operational costs, limited scalability, ADA non-compliance, and slow development cycles. A modern, cost-efficient, and scalable solution was needed to enhance user experience and drive growth.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts modernized the consumer payment portal by migrating it from Mosaic to React.js, with the merchant portal migration underway. The project focused on scalability, cost efficiency, and accessibility:

  • Modern Front-End Framework: Migrated to React.js for enhanced performance, accessibility, and faster development.
  • Reusable UI Framework: Cut UI development costs by 50%, streamlining future enhancements.
  • Optimized API Management: Transitioned from Kong Gateway to AWS API Gateway, saving $1,300 monthly.
  • ADA Compliance: Ensured inclusive design for broader accessibility.
  • Infrastructure Upgrade: Moved hosting and API management to AWS, improving scalability and reducing operational costs.
  • Streamlined Deployments: Implemented CI/CD pipelines for efficient and reliable updates.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React.js
  • Backend: AWS API Gateway
  • Infrastructure: AWS Services (Elastic Beanstalk, S3)
  • Compliance: ADA standards
  • Development: CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment

story.title: New Lease of Life for a Legacy Field Safety Application
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts migrated a Canadian occupational health and safety mobile app from Xamarin to .NET MAUI ahead of Xamarin's 2024 end-of-support.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts migrated a Canadian occupational health and safety mobile app from Xamarin to .NET MAUI ahead of Xamarin's 2024 end-of-support.

benefits.title: 30% Faster Development
benefits.description: Unified codebase reduced cross-platform development and maintenance time.

benefits.title: Improved Responsiveness
benefits.description: Enhanced performance boosted user satisfaction and operational reliability.

benefits.title: Seamless Offline Functionality
benefits.description: Ensured uninterrupted app usability in remote, low-connectivity areas.

benefits.title: Future-Ready Technology
benefits.description: Positioned the business for scalable growth and alignment with modern app trends.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading Canadian occupational health and safety company relied on a mobile app to manage field safety incidents across remote worksites. However, the app faced critical challenges:

  • Imminent End-of-Support for Xamarin (May 2024), risking operational continuity.
  • Performance and compatibility issues with modern Android and iOS systems, causing sluggishness and affecting reliability in the field.

To ensure uninterrupted operations, scalability, and alignment with modern technology standards, the client required a seamless migration to a sustainable framework.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts successfully migrated the app to .NET MAUI, delivering a modern, scalable, and user-friendly solution.

  • Streamlined Migration: Simplified the transition using Prism .NET MAUI with minimal disruptions.
  • Enhanced Performance: Updated to the latest .NET version for faster load times and smoother navigation.
  • Offline Usability: Improved data synchronization for seamless operations in low-connectivity areas.
  • Accurate Geolocation: Boosted precision for reliable field safety reporting.
  • Modernized Interface: Redesigned with XAML and native controls for intuitive navigation and responsiveness.
  • Future-Ready Infrastructure: Integrated Azure Elastic DB Pool, Azure Functions, and Azure Web App for scalability and security.
  • Critical Safety Features: Retained emergency help and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) functionalities.

Technology Stack

  • Frameworks: .NET MAUI, ASP.NET Web API
  • Cloud Services: Azure Elastic DB Pool, Azure Functions, Azure Web App
  • Database: MS SQL, SQLite
  • Tools & Patterns: Prism, XAML, MVVM Architecture

story.title: Optimizing Cost Savings with Power BI Analytics
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built Power BI dashboards for a fintech firm, tracking planned versus actual cost savings across infrastructure, personnel, and operations.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built Power BI dashboards for a fintech firm, tracking planned versus actual cost savings across infrastructure, personnel, and operations.

benefits.title: Improved Financial Insights
benefits.description: Unified cost-saving data improved oversight and accelerated decision-making.

benefits.title: Optimized Expenses
benefits.description: Identified areas of overspending, reducing unnecessary expenses by 15%.

benefits.title: Increased Efficiency
benefits.description: Automated reporting decreased manual analysis by 40%, allowing teams to focus on strategic goals.

benefits.title: Actionable Vendor Data
benefits.description: Delivered performance insights, enhancing vendor negotiations and resource management strategies.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading fintech organization aimed to optimize its cost-saving initiatives by tracking planned versus actual savings across infrastructure, personnel, and operational expenses. Challenges included inefficient manual analysis, limited visibility into vendor performance, and a lack of insights into spending trends. The client required a comprehensive, data-driven solution to enhance financial decision-making and streamline vendor management.

Technology Solution

We leveraged Power BI to create tailored, interactive dashboards that addressed the client’s challenges:

  • Cost-Savings Insights: Delivered reports on infrastructure, personnel, and operational expense savings, clearly comparing planned and actual savings.
  • Vendor Analytics: Provided detailed vendor performance metrics to identify top performers, manage overspending, and optimize costs.
  • Trend Analysis: Identified spending patterns, enabling strategic resource allocation and cost-saving adjustments.
  • Dynamic Visualizations: Designed intuitive dashboards with filters for period, division, and vendor categories, supported by drilldowns for in-depth data exploration.
  • Data Integrity: Built ETL pipelines and utilized SQL Server to ensure accuracy and consistency of data feeding into Power BI reports.

Technology Stack

  • Power BI for reporting and visualization
  • SQL Server for data storage and processing
  • ETL Pipelines for seamless data preparation.

story.title: Optimizing Enterprise Document Management with SharePoint
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a SharePoint document management system for a growing enterprise, integrating Copilot search, Power Automate, and Azure AD RBAC.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a SharePoint document management system for a growing enterprise, integrating Copilot search, Power Automate, and Azure AD RBAC.

benefits.title: Faster Document Retrieval
benefits.description: 50% improvement in search efficiency with AI-powered search and metadata tagging.

benefits.title: Eliminated Versioning Conflicts
benefits.description: A single source of truth with version control reduced duplication and miscommunication.

benefits.title: Enhanced Security & Compliance
benefits.description: Structured access controls and audit logging ensured regulatory compliance.

benefits.title: Optimized Contract Processing
benefits.description: Reduction in contract approval times with automated workflows.

benefits.title: Cost Savings

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A growing enterprise managing client contracts, product documentation, and internal resources faced challenges in organizing, securing, and retrieving critical files. Existing documentation was scattered across multiple cloud drives, emails, and local devices, making searchability inefficient and increasing security risks. Additionally, version control issues led to duplication and miscommunication. Since the company was already on Office 365, a cost-effective, built-in solution was necessary to streamline document management without additional licensing costs.

Technology Solution

We implemented a SharePoint-based document management system to enhance searchability, security, and collaboration while integrating seamlessly with the existing Office 365 ecosystem:

  • Structured Document Storage: Designed a hierarchical SharePoint folder structure for client, department, and project-based document storage with metadata tagging for quick retrieval.
  • Enhanced Search with AI: Integrated SharePoint Copilot for natural language search and Microsoft Search with metadata filters for precision retrieval.
  • Version Control & Collaboration: Enabled SharePoint Online’s version history and real-time co-authoring with Microsoft 365, preventing version conflicts and miscommunication.
  • Security & Access Management: Configured Azure AD Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to enforce secure document access, preventing unauthorized sharing.
  • Automated Workflows & Expiration Alerts: Used Power Automate to streamline document approvals and trigger contract expiration notifications.
  • Compliance & Security Policies: Activated Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SharePoint audit logging to track access and modifications.

Technology Stack

  • Document Management: SharePoint Online
  • AI-Powered Search: SharePoint Copilot, Microsoft Search
  • Security & Compliance: Azure AD (RBAC), Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
  • Workflow Automation: Power Automate

story.title: Optimizing Legal Operations with Automated Timekeeping and Invoicing
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built an automated timekeeping and invoicing module for law firms, capturing billable hours and syncing with QuickBooks in real time.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built an automated timekeeping and invoicing module for law firms, capturing billable hours and syncing with QuickBooks in real time.

benefits.title: 35% Increase in Recorded Billable Hours
benefits.description: Automated tracking minimized unrecorded hours.

benefits.title: Streamlined Invoicing
benefits.description: Reduced errors and manual effort through automated workflows.

benefits.title: Increased Productivity
benefits.description: Attorneys saved significant time to focus on legal work.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Accurate billing is critical for law firms, but many struggle with capturing billable hours and managing manual invoicing. This resulted in unrecorded revenue, inefficiencies, and frequent errors in billing.

Technology Solution

A sophisticated Timekeeping and Invoicing module was implemented to automate time tracking and billing:

  • Automated Time Tracking: Captured billable and non-billable hours using customizable categories and codes.
  • End-to-End Invoicing: Automated invoice generation, approval workflows, and payment processing.
  • QuickBooks Integration: Enabled real-time synchronization with accounting systems for seamless financial operations.

Technology Stack

  • QuickBooks Integration
  • .NET Core Web API
  • SQL Server

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A US-based fintech company faced significant accessibility challenges with its React.js payment platform, which did not meet ADA compliance or WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines. The platform's poor keyboard navigation, lack of screen reader support, and inadequate color contrast ratios excluded users with disabilities and posed legal risks. To improve usability and regulatory compliance, the client required a comprehensive accessibility solution.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts implemented a holistic strategy to remediate accessibility gaps and align the platform with modern standards for inclusivity:

  • Accessibility Audit: Conducted an in-depth audit using Deque’s Axe Accessibility Suite to identify WCAG 2.1 AA violations.
  • Semantic and Visual Enhancements: Optimized HTML elements for accessibility, improved color contrast to meet a 4.5:1 ratio, and integrated scalable fonts for better readability.
  • Screen Reader Optimization: Added ARIA roles and live regions to support dynamic content and ensure clear, descriptive labeling.
  • Keyboard Navigation: Enabled logical focus order, keyboard-focusable elements, and skip-to-content links for seamless navigation.
  • Automated Testing: Integrated Axe tools into the CI/CD pipeline for proactive accessibility checks during development cycles.

Technology Stack

  • Framework: React.js
  • Audit Tools: Deque’s Axe Accessibility Suite
  • Compliance Standards: WCAG 2.1 AA

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leader in medical product recall management faced challenges in modernizing their paper-based recall process into a scalable web-based platform. Inefficiencies in communication, delays in managing recall actions, and risks to patient safety underscored the need for a robust solution. The platform required validation for large-scale data handling, stakeholder-specific functionalities, and seamless performance under real-world conditions to meet regulatory and operational demands.

Technology Solution

A comprehensive QA strategy was implemented to ensure functionality, scalability, and reliability:

  • Persistent QA Environment: Pre-configured with realistic data for repeatable tests, simulating workflows for suppliers and providers.
  • Volume Testing: Simulated scenarios involving 5,000 supplier locations, 2,400 provider users, and 4,000 affected locations to validate large-scale operations.
  • Automated Testing: Built a Selenium-based regression suite to reduce manual testing, speed up updates, and validate stakeholder workflows.
  • Workflow Validation: Combined manual and automated testing to ensure seamless stakeholder-specific operations.

Technology Stack

  • Automation Tools: Selenium
  • Backend: SQL Server for data management
  • Cloud: Azure for hosting QA environments
  • Frameworks: .NET Core for platform integration

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A global pharmaceutical company faced significant challenges with its outdated legacy web portal, including recurring bugs, inadequate security protocols, and poor user experience. The platform lacked reliability, scalability, and modern features, resulting in operational inefficiencies and user dissatisfaction. A comprehensive transformation was needed to enhance security, functionality, and overall performance.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts transformed the legacy platform into a secure and scalable web portal with modern features:

  • Modern Tech Stack: Migrated the backend from ASP.NET to Node.js and revamped the frontend with React, delivering a responsive and user-friendly interface.
  • Enhanced Security: Integrated AWS Cognito for secure authentication and OTP-based password recovery, ensuring compliance with modern security standards. Implemented Role-Based Access Control, restricting access by user roles (external, internal, admin), and strengthening data security.
  • Actionable Analytics: Actionable insights allowed the admin team to enhance SEO and boost user engagement.

Technology Stack

  • Backend: Node.js
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript
  • Database: MySQL
  • Authentication: AWS Cognito

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A legacy recall management system faced delays in identifying and responding to product recalls, risking customer safety and trust. Disparate data sources further caused compliance risks and inefficiencies, necessitating an automated solution for data scraping, inventory file processing, and timely recall responses.

Technology Solution

To address these challenges, IncubXperts implemented an AI-driven solution with the following advancements:

  • Built a scalable batch processing system for ingesting openFDA recall data, ensuring efficient and accurate updates.
  • Used AI-powered data scraping with rule-based algorithms and Amazon Textract to extract data from PDFs, intelligently prioritize critical recall information, and reduce response times.
  • Developed a responsive web application for seamless access, filtering, and sorting of recall data across devices.
  • Secured integration with openFDA’s UDI recall searches to enhance data accessibility and maintain privacy.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: Vue.js
  • Database: MongoDB
  • Backend & Scripting: Python, Node.js
  • Cloud Services: AWS Lambda, AWS Batch, S3, EC2
  • Containerization: Docker
  • AI & Data Processing: AWS SageMaker, AWS Textract

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A workplace safety company faced challenges with outdated legacy systems that hindered incident reporting and compliance. Clients operating in industries like construction and healthcare required a modern mobile platform to ensure service continuity in low-connectivity areas, streamline incident reporting, and enhance safety compliance. Manual reporting processes were inefficient, error-prone, and lacked accessibility, necessitating an AI-driven mobile solution to improve accuracy and engagement.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an AI-powered, cross-platform mobile solution to transform workplace safety reporting and compliance. Key features include:

  • AI-Driven Assistant for Incident Reporting: Replaced manual reporting with an intelligent speech-to-text assistant, leveraging natural language processing and noise-resilient voice recognition to ensure accurate and timely documentation, even in noisy industrial environments.
  • Offline and Location-Aware Functionality: Enabled seamless usability and data integrity in low-connectivity regions through offline data synchronization and a location-aware framework, ensuring accessibility for remote workers.
  • Dynamic User Experience: A backend-configurable interface personalized the app to workplace safety needs, providing an intuitive user experience tailored to each user’s role.
  • Integrated Safety Features: Incorporated emergency "Work Alone" functionality for solo worker safety and Canada’s Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for compliance with chemical safety protocols.

Technology Stack

  • Front-End: MAUI, Prism
  • Back-End: ASP.NET Web API, Azure Functions, Azure Web App,
  • Database: Azure Elastic DB Pool, MS SQL
  • AI and Cognitive Services: Azure Cognitive Services, Microsoft BOT Framework V4, LUIS, Azure Speech Service

story.title: Sales Intelligence Assistant: Revolutionizing Sales Operations with AI-Powered Insights
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built an AI sales assistant using multi-agent orchestration, unifying Gmail, Calendar, and HubSpot CRM with Claude Sonnet 4 and GPT-4o.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built an AI sales assistant using multi-agent orchestration, unifying Gmail, Calendar, and HubSpot CRM with Claude Sonnet 4 and GPT-4o.

benefits.title: Context in Seconds
benefits.description: Eliminates tool-switching by unifying email, calendar, and CRM into seamless context.

benefits.title: Smarter Meetings
benefits.description: AI-generated briefs help teams enter meetings fully prepared.

benefits.title: Improved Deal Visibility
benefits.description: Real-time, multi-source updates reduce missed follow-ups and delays.

benefits.title: On-the-Go Flexibility
benefits.description: Podcast-style AI audio briefings transform static reports into mobile narratives.

benefits.title: Enterprise-Ready Design
benefits.description: Modular, cloud-native architecture scales seamlessly and integrates securely with sales stacks.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Sales teams spend excessive time piecing together context from multiple disconnected sources. Emails reside in Gmail, meetings populate Google Calendar, and sales opportunities live in HubSpot CRM—all siloed. Preparing for client meetings requires manual searching through threads, agendas, and deal notes. Opportunity tracking means toggling across these platforms, leading to missed follow-ups, slower deal cycles, and diminished productivity.

Technology Solution

To solve this fragmentation, the Sales Intelligence platform uses composable multi-agent AI orchestration to unify data from multiple sources and deliver actionable, real-time insights. Key components include:

  • Composio AI Integration: Orchestrates Gmail, Google Calendar, and HubSpot CRM data into a unified context.
  • MCP Server/API: Manages natural language query routing and aggregates multi-source responses with contextual consistency.
  • AI Summarization & Reasoning: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4 condenses emails, meetings, and CRM data into concise briefs; OpenAI GPT-4o extracts user intent and formats responses clearly.
  • Conversational Chatbot UI: React-based chatbot supports natural language prompts such as “Show me recent emails with Greenline Solar” or “Prep me for Client Training Kickoff.”
  • Multi-Modal Delivery: Offers dashboard visualization and podcast-style audio briefings via OpenAI TTS so sales reps can listen while on the move.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Material UI, WebSocket audio streaming
  • Backend: Node.js, Express, AWS SDK (S3, Textract, Transcribe, Bedrock), Firebase Admin
  • AI Models: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4, OpenAI GPT-4o, OpenAI TTS
  • Integrations: Gmail, Google Calendar, HubSpot CRM via Composio AI
  • Storage: Firestore and AWS S3

story.title: Saving Lives with Technology: Snakebite Response Management
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts partnered with a pharma firm and Indian government to build a snakebite response Xamarin app on Azure, integrating Twilio and Google Maps.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts partnered with a pharma firm and Indian government to build a snakebite response Xamarin app on Azure, integrating Twilio and Google Maps.

benefits.title: Life-Saving Efficiency
benefits.description: Reduced fatalities during critical golden hours by enabling real-time assistance.

benefits.title: Enhanced Medical Access
benefits.description: Treatment within the golden hour increased by 65%, improving survival outcomes.

benefits.title: Accelerated Response Times
benefits.description: Reduced response times from 40 minutes to 15 minutes.

benefits.title: Streamlined Medical Logistics
benefits.description: Integration of anti-venom inventory systems and health centers reduced logistical delays by 70%.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

India reports the highest number of snakebite incidents globally, making timely medical intervention during the critical golden hour essential to save lives. A reliable, technology-driven solution was needed to enhance the reporting, monitoring, and administration of medical assistance for snakebite victims, ensuring swift and accurate response mechanisms.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts collaborated with a leading pharmaceutical company and the Indian government to develop a comprehensive digital framework for snakebite management and response. Key solution highlights include:

  • Mobile Application and Web Solution: Developed using Xamarin and hosted on Azure, seamlessly integrated with anti-venom inventory systems to ensure timely medical interventions.
  • Google Maps Integration: Facilitated navigation to the nearest equipped healthcare facilities for rapid and precise medical care.
  • Real-Time Communication: Leveraged Twilio's cloud-based call center to create a communication triangle, connecting victims with medical professionals for immediate guidance.

Technology Stack

  • Backend: ASP.NET Web API, ASP.NET MVC 5
  • Frontend: Android, Xamarin
  • Database: MS SQL Server, Azure SQL Database
  • Cloud & Hosting: Azure Web App
  • Analytics & Notifications: Firebase Analytics
  • Communication & Mapping: Twilio Cloud Telephony API (Outbound/Inbound Calls, SMS), Google Maps Integration

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A 15+ year-old social initiative teaching essential life skills across 30 cities and engaging 700+ volunteers needed a scalable, cost-effective technology solution to manage operations, streamline processes, and ensure demographic-wide engagement.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a Azure-based technology suite to unify and automate the initiative’s operations, achieving:

  • Master Data Management: Streamlined 15+ years of historical data for accessible insights and decision-making.
  • Automated Workflows: Reduced manual tasks, enhancing efficiency and enabling focus on strategic goals.
  • Operational Framework: Strengthened execution and governance to align activities with core objectives.
  • Cross-Platform Mobile App: Expanded engagement with a unified app for iOS and Android, reducing development costs.

Technology Stack

ASP.NET MVC, Azure PaaS, MS SQL Server, Xamarin

story.bodyHtml:
**Business Problem**

A US-based fintech company specializing in online payments, check processing, and ACH services relied on legacy systems, including Windows Server 2008 R2 and older .NET Framework versions. These outdated platforms posed critical challenges:

• Security vulnerabilities and non-compliance with PCI DSS standards.

• Inefficiencies impacting system performance and scalability.

• Operational disruptions due to manual workflows and frequent downtimes. To ensure secure and uninterrupted operations, the client required a comprehensive modernization of their infrastructure and applications.

**Technology Solution**

To address these challenges, IncubXperts implemented a comprehensive migration strategy to modernize the client’s systems while ensuring operational continuity.

Key Highlights:

IncubXperts streamlined the client’s systems with a phased modernization strategy that emphasized security, performance, and compliance:

  • Seamless Migration: Conducted staged migrations with parallel environments, ensuring zero downtime and smooth transitions.

  • Compliance Assurance: Collaborated with PCI QSAs, performed vulnerability scans, and resolved security gaps to achieve PCI DSS certification.

  • Operational Optimization: Enhanced workflows with automation and implemented robust monitoring tools for post-migration performance tracking.

Before & After Migration: A Clear Transformation


Aspect Before Migration After Migration
Infrastructure Outdated Windows Server 2008 R2 and SQL Server 2012 Upgraded to Windows Server 2019 and SQL Server 2016
Application Framework Legacy .NET Framework versions Migrated to modern .NET 5.0
Security Exposed to vulnerabilities, non-compliant systems Fully PCI DSS compliant with enhanced security
Performance Sluggish response times and frequent downtime 40% improvement in performance and reliability
Compliance High risk of fines and legal issues Successful PCI certification achieved
Operations Manual processes and inefficiencies Streamlined workflows with automation

**Technology Stack**

  • Infrastructure: Windows Server 2019, SQL Server 2016

  • Application Framework: .NET 5.0

  • Compliance Tools: Portability Analyzer, Accunetix

Business Problem

A financial services platform serving banks, credit unions, healthcare providers, and property managers faced challenges in modernizing its legacy systems. Critical issues included:

  • Migrating 350+ clients to a modern platform without operational disruptions.
  • Simplifying new client onboarding while maintaining service quality.
  • Managing ongoing change requests and enhancements for legacy system clients.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts provided a tailored solution to streamline client implementations and enhance scalability:

  • Automated Data Migration: Built scripts and SSIS packages for accurate and secure data transfers.

  • Integrated APIs: Enabled seamless communication with third-party systems to extend functionality.
  • 24/7 Support: Provided comprehensive technical assistance and knowledge management for uninterrupted operations.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading Australian software services company faced a critical gap in real-time vehicle tracking and route optimization. Serving diverse clients, including driving schools and transportation services, the lack of these capabilities impacted logistical efficiency and client satisfaction, requiring an innovative solution.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts created an advanced Location Tracking System seamlessly integrated into the company’s software ecosystem. Using geolocation APIs and Progressive Web App (PWA) technologies, the solution enabled real-time vehicle tracking and dynamic visualization.

Key features included:

  • Real-time geolocation using the Media Devices API.
  • Background location updates powered by PWA Service Workers.
  • Robust data synchronization between vehicle locations and the central database.
  • Tailored tracking features for transportation and logistics, enhancing precision and usability.

Technology Stack

  • MVC
  • JavaScript
  • jQuery
  • SQL

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Fuel logistics relied on disconnected systems for procurement and transporter selection, leading to inefficiencies, longer turnaround times, and manual errors in billing and rate management. A comprehensive integration was needed to streamline operations and enhance decision-making in the fuel supply chain.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts designed an intelligent rate management system to enhance the efficiency of the fuel marketplace platform:

  • Dynamic Rate Cards: Centralized storage of transporter rate cards for real-time access and updates.
  • Configurable Pricing Rules: Tailored pricing strategies with adjustable rules for market adaptability.
  • Smart Transporter Selection: Integrated comparison tools to recommend optimal transporters for specific orders.
  • Automated Billing: Real-time invoice generation and additional fee calculations for accuracy and transparency.
  • Adaptive Pricing Models: Support for multiple billing structures, such as per kilometer, route-based, or fixed pricing.

Technology Stack

Angular, .NET Core, MongoDB, .NET Core Web API

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A growing enterprise firm faced inefficiencies in sharing and managing internal knowledge. Critical documents like policies, SOPs, and training guides were scattered across emails, shared folders, and personal drives, leading to outdated information and duplication. New employees struggled with onboarding due to limited access to structured resources, while HR and IT teams were overwhelmed by repetitive inquiries.

Technology Solution

We implemented a SharePoint-powered Knowledge Hub to centralize and streamline document management and self-service support:

  • Centralized Repository: Created a structured library for storing and organizing company policies, SOPs, training materials, and best practices with metadata tagging for easier filtering.
  • Enhanced Search and Navigation: Configured SharePoint search with custom filters and added quick links for commonly accessed documents, improving accessibility.
  • Self-Service Support: Integrated Microsoft Forms and Power Automate to enable employees to submit HR or IT queries and receive automated responses with relevant knowledge base articles.
  • Secure Document Access: Used Azure Active Directory for role-based permissions, ensuring sensitive documents were accessible only to authorized personnel.

Technology Stack

  • SharePoint Online: Document storage and knowledge hub.
  • Microsoft Search: Enhanced document filtering and navigation.
  • Power Automate: Automated query responses.
  • Microsoft Forms: Self-service query submission.
  • Azure Active Directory (AAD): Role-based access control.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

An enterprise needed to consolidate communication channels for streamlined client interactions. The goal was to integrate Slack with Twilio, enabling direct and efficient text message exchanges, improving responsiveness, and simplifying workflows for customer communication.

Technology Solution

Developed a seamless Twilio-Slack integration using a serverless architecture. Key advancements include:

  • Azure Function as Webhook: Processes inbound messages from Twilio and relays them to Slack.
  • Two-Way Communication: Ensures messages sent from Slack are transmitted back to Twilio for external delivery.
  • Smart Slack Bot: Provides context-aware responses and visualizes meeting schedules, enhancing user interaction and communication efficiency.

Technology Stack

Azure Functions, Echo BOT, Storage accounts

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Multi-location associations faced inefficiencies in managing member services, billing, event operations, and board collaboration. Disjointed workflows, inconsistent member experiences, and fragmented communication hindered their ability to scale and engage effectively. They needed a centralized digital platform to streamline operations, improve member engagement, and provide actionable insights.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts helped develop a tailored Association Management System (AMS) and CRM SaaS platform to address the unique needs of this space:

  • Membership Management: Centralized tracking of member data, renewals, and interactions with real-time updates for improved accuracy and insights.
  • Automated Billing and Payments: Integrated workflows for seamless one-time and recurring payments, auto-updating the system post-transaction.
  • Event Management: Enabled smooth planning and execution of in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, with streamlined attendee sign-ups and CEU tracking.
  • Board and Committee Collaboration: Tools for activity tracking, shared spaces for transparency, and streamlined decision-making.
  • Scalable and Intuitive Design: A future-ready platform capable of supporting additional members and association chapters.

Technology Stack

• Backend: .NET Core

• Frontend: Angular

• Database: MySQL

• Cloud Services: Azure

• Integrations: Authorize.Net, Solr

story.title: Streamlining Payment Processing with a Unified SaaS Platform
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a PCI DSS and HIPAA-compliant SaaS payment platform for a financial services firm, unifying check-clearing and digital payments.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a PCI DSS and HIPAA-compliant SaaS payment platform for a financial services firm, unifying check-clearing and digital payments.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A financial services firm faced inefficiencies in check-clearing and payment processes, resulting in high operational costs, payment delays, and compliance risks. With fragmented workflows for paper-based and digital transactions, they required a centralized platform to automate processes, unify receivables, and adhere to PCI DSS and HIPAA standards.

Technology Solution

We developed a scalable, SaaS-based payment platform that automates workflows, enhances compliance, and unifies payment systems:

  • Unified Payment Workflows: Centralized system for automating check-clearing and online payments, with receivables management and automated return processing.
  • SaaS Flexibility: Delivered full-service and API-based models, allowing businesses to tailor solutions while ensuring scalability.
  • Compliance and Security: Implemented PCI DSS and HIPAA standards with field-level encryption and real-time auditing tools, ensuring end-to-end data protection.
  • Streamlined Operations: Automated ACH, ICL, and onboarding workflows, reducing manual tasks and improving operational efficiency.
  • Dynamic Reporting and Dashboards: Real-time analytics for payment tracking, return management, and trend analysis.
  • Seamless Integrations: Open APIs for merchant system integration, supporting omnichannel workflows like RDC, ATM, and mobile capture.

Technology Stack

  • Backend: Java, Spring
  • Frontend: React
  • Database: PostgreSQL
  • Hosting: AWS
  • Other Tools: Wildfly, Open APIs

story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts integrated Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM with a legacy QuoteGen Power App, enabling real-time sync, dashboards, and CRM Queues.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts integrated Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM with a legacy QuoteGen Power App, enabling real-time sync, dashboards, and CRM Queues.

benefits.description: Unified data between QuoteGen and CRM for a seamless sales workflow.

benefits.title: Improved Data Accuracy

benefits.title: Better Sales Insights
benefits.description: Real-time dashboards provided actionable data for smarter decision-making.

benefits.title: Efficient Quote Handling
benefits.description: Automated CRM queues reduced turnaround time and improved process efficiency.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The client had a legacy Power App (Canvas App) - QuoteGen - for quote generation but faced inefficiencies due to disconnected systems, datatype conversion errors, limited sales visibility, and manual quote assignment. Without real-time synchronization with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, sales teams struggled with inconsistent data, slow processes, and a lack of actionable insights, leading to delays and errors in quote management.

Technology Solution

We integrated Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM with QuoteGen, enabling seamless data flow, automation, and improved sales efficiency.

Key Implementations included -

  • Quote & Quoteline Entities: Designed and mapped CRM entities to QuoteGen tables for a unified data structure.
  • Seamless Data Integration: Ensured real-time data synchronization between QuoteGen and CRM for accurate tracking.
  • Datatype Conversion Handling: Converted numerical amount fields to currency format in CRM to align with financial standards.
  • Sales Dashboards: Developed interactive dashboards to provide real-time insights into quotes and conversions.
  • CRM Queues: Automated quote assignments and processing, reducing manual effort and increasing efficiency.

Technology Stack

  • CRM: Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • App Platform: Power Apps (Canvas App - QuoteGen)
  • Automation & Integration: Power Automate
  • Data Management: Dataverse

story.title: Streamlining Recruitment with Power BI for a Leading FinTech Company
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts replaced Excel-based recruitment tracking with a Power BI analytics platform for a growing fintech firm, adding predictive hiring insights.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts replaced Excel-based recruitment tracking with a Power BI analytics platform for a growing fintech firm, adding predictive hiring insights.

benefits.description: Automated reporting reduced manual effort by 40%, allowing HR teams to focus on strategic initiatives.

benefits.title: Improved Hiring Timelines
benefits.description: Predictive analytics accelerated the fulfillment of open positions by 20%, improving workforce readiness.

benefits.title: Data-Driven Decision-Making
benefits.description: Real-time insights supported better resource allocation and proactive workforce planning.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A fast-growing FinTech company relied heavily on manual, Excel-based recruitment processes, which led to inefficiencies, errors, and limited visibility into critical hiring data. Without automated reporting or predictive insights, the company struggled to streamline workflows, forecast future workforce requirements, and align recruitment strategies with business goals. These inefficiencies hindered scalability and the ability to attract and onboard top talent effectively.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts implemented a robust recruitment analytics platform using Power BI, tailored to the client's unique needs.

Key features included:

  • Dynamic Recruitment Dashboards: Interactive dashboards for tracking open positions, onboarding progress, and leader-specific hiring metrics.
  • Predictive Analytics: Forecasting recruitment timelines and identifying trends in skillsets, experience levels, and location preferences.
  • Automated Reporting: Streamlined data collection and visualization to reduce manual errors and provide real-time insights.
  • Customizable Filters: Filters for period, location, and role, enabling tailored reports for different business needs.
  • Process Optimization: Insights into onboarding timelines helped reduce employee induction time and improve new hire satisfaction.

Technology Stack

  • Power BI
  • SQL Server for data storage and processing.
  • Custom ETL Pipelines to ensure data consistency and accuracy for Power BI dashboards.

story.title: Transforming Community Wellness with a  Mobile Solution for an Upscale American Neighborhood
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built a React Native community wellness mobile app for an upscale US neighborhood, tracking health activities and awarding wellness points.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built a React Native community wellness mobile app for an upscale US neighborhood, tracking health activities and awarding wellness points.

benefits.title: Data-Driven Decisions
benefits.description: The app's analytics provided key insights, helping administrators optimize wellness programs based on resident activity and preferences.

benefits.title: Enhanced Communication
benefits.description: Integrated push notifications led to a 25% increase in timely engagement, ensuring residents stayed informed and motivated.

benefits.title: Improved Administrative Efficiency
benefits.description: The Admin Tool reduced manual administrative tasks by 40%, streamlining user management and reporting, allowing city officials to focus on strategic decisions.

benefits.title: Increased Resident Engagement
benefits.description: The app boosted community wellness program participation by 30%, with residents actively tracking fitness goals and earning wellness points as incentives.

benefits.title: Scalability & Security
benefits.description: With AWS and Firebase, the platform can scale to accommodate growing user bases while ensuring data privacy and security.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Residents of an upscale community in the USA lacked a unified platform to track and manage fitness activities, resulting in reduced participation in community wellness programs. The absence of an integrated solution made it challenging for city administrators to manage logistics and communicate effectively. The city aimed to increase resident engagement and streamline administrative processes through a comprehensive mobile application.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a specialized mobile app for both Android and iOS platforms, complemented by an Admin Tool to enhance fitness tracking and program management.

  • The app allows residents to track their health activities (such as blood pressure, weight, and daily food intake), set personal goals, and earn wellness points for active participation.
  • The Admin Tool enables efficient user management, message handling, and reporting capabilities, streamlining administrative processes and ensuring smooth program operations.
  • Role-based access control, secure authentication, and AWS scalability ensure data privacy, secure administration, and platform growth.
  • Firebase push notifications and cron jobs automate wellness point calculations and user reminders.

Technology Stack

  • React Native
  • Spring Boot
  • Nest JS
  • Angular
  • Docker
  • SQL
  • AWS

story.title: Transforming eSports Betting with AI-Powered Bidding and Real-Time Insights
story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts built an AI-powered NBA eSports betting platform with dynamic bidding, real-time analytics via Sportsradar, and live WebSocket updates.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts built an AI-powered NBA eSports betting platform with dynamic bidding, real-time analytics via Sportsradar, and live WebSocket updates.

benefits.title: Increased Engagement
benefits.description: AI-powered analytics and interactive features significantly boosted user satisfaction and platform loyalty.

benefits.title: Improved Win Rates
benefits.description: Personalized betting recommendations enhanced decision-making and user success.

benefits.title: Strengthened Market Competitiveness
benefits.description: Real-time alerts and innovative AI features positioned the platform as an emerging choice in eSports betting.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

The fast-paced world of eSports betting demands real-time, data-driven insights for smarter decision-making. Current platforms lack advanced features like win probabilities, live scores, competitive odds, and continuous match updates, resulting in a poor user experience and missed opportunities. A sophisticated AI-powered platform was needed to deliver real-time analytics, predictive modeling, and a smarter bidding engine to enhance engagement and optimize betting decisions.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed an advanced NBA eSports betting platform with an AI-powered bidding engine, real-time analytics, and a seamless user experience. Key features include:

  • AI-Powered Bidding Engine: Adjusts bid and ask prices dynamically with AI and rule-based logic, providing personalized recommendations based on user history, market conditions, and live data.
  • Sports Data Integration: Leveraged APIs like Sportsradar for real-time match insights, including win probabilities, live scores, and odds.
  • Interactive and Customizable UI: Included interactive sliders, risk alerts, team toggles, and live news feeds to enhance engagement and usability.
  • Real-Time Data Management: Used WebSocket and RESTful APIs for live updates and efficient data handling.
  • Robust Security: Implemented user authentication, SSL encryption, and secure API key storage to ensure privacy and data integrity.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend and Backend: JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js
  • Database: PostgreSQL
  • Real-Time Communication: WebSocket, Socket.io
  • Sports Data API Integration: Sportsradar API, Modulus API
  • Security: SSL Certificates, Authentication
  • Infrastructure: EC2 Instance, Nginx
  • AI Services: Azure Machine Learning Studio

story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts co-developed a multi-tenant legal ERP for US law firms, unifying billing, trust accounting, matter management, and QuickBooks integration.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts co-developed a multi-tenant legal ERP for US law firms, unifying billing, trust accounting, matter management, and QuickBooks integration.

benefits.title: Accurate Billing & Revenue Growth
benefits.description: Automated timekeeping increased recorded billable hours by 35%, ensuring precise invoicing and maximizing revenue realization.

benefits.title: Cost Savings
benefits.description: Consolidated ERP functionality cut technology overheads by 30%, improving financial efficiency.

benefits.title: Enhanced Data Security
benefits.description: Multi-tenant architecture provided firm-specific databases, reducing security incidents by 40% and boosting client trust.

benefits.title: Improved Operational Efficiency
benefits.description: The unified platform streamlined legal workflows, reducing manual processes by 50% and integrating QuickBooks for financial tracking and DocuSign for secure document management.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

American law firms face operational inefficiencies due to the manual handling of high paperwork volumes, tracking billable hours, and managing complex billing cycles for contingency-based cases. Disconnected systems and the lack of an integrated platform further added to the operational burden, underscoring the need for a centralized solution to optimize workflows and improve accuracy.

Technology Solution

We co-developed a scalable, multi-tenant ERP platform tailored to law firms, streamlining key legal operations such as billing, scheduling, trust accounting, and document management.

Key Features:

  • Unified Practice Management: Centralized matter management, billing, payments, and financial tracking under one platform.
  • Secure Multi-Tenant SSO: Azure AD B2C-powered authentication with robust login, recovery, and security protocols.
  • Advanced Document Search: Azure Cognitive Search integrated with Azure Blob Storage for deep searches across matters, employees, and documents.
  • Integrated Financial Tools and Trust Accounting: Features like QuickBooks integration and trust accounting simplify financial management while maintaining compliance.
  • Timekeeping and Billing Automation: Automates tracking of billable hours and e-invoicing, ensuring billing accuracy and approval.
  • Customizable Dashboards and Reporting: High-level views and filters for quick access to case data, workflows, and reports.
  • DocuSign Integration: AI-driven document management with automated classification and encryption.
  • Calendar Syncing: Bi-directional syncing with popular calendar tools to streamline meeting scheduling.

Technology Stack

Azure AD B2C, Azure Cognitive Search, Azure Blob Storage, .NET MVC, Angular 9, SQL Server, QuickBooks Integration, Selenium for QA Testing

story.heroSummary: How IncubXperts customized Dynamics 365 for a global firm with a 2,000-product catalog, integrating airSlate and adding multi-currency quoting.
story.metaDescription: How IncubXperts customized Dynamics 365 for a global firm with a 2,000-product catalog, integrating airSlate and adding multi-currency quoting.

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Managing a globally distributed team and an expansive product catalog presented the following challenges:

  • Process Inconsistencies: Lack of standardized workflows across global regions.
  • Complex Quoting: Inefficient handling of 2,000+ products and configurations.
  • Operational Inefficiencies: Manual processes caused delays and miscommunications.
  • Scaling Challenges: Hindered team and operational scalability.
  • Customer Experience Issues: Quoting errors impacted trust and satisfaction.

Technology Solution

  • CRM Customization & Workflow Optimization: Conducted a Fit-Gap analysis, streamlined workflows, and customized Dynamics 365 to track complex product properties.
  • Enterprise Integration: Integrated Dynamics 365 with invoicing systems, airSlate for contract automation, and the activation portal for workflow efficiency.
  • Enhanced Quoting Capabilities: Supported multi-currency, single-currency, and foreign exchange quoting for global sales.
  • Performance Optimization: Archived historical case data to reduce storage costs and improve CRM performance.
  • Robust Security & Scalability: Applied field-level encryption, AWS Cognito for authentication, and AWS-hosted infrastructure for seamless scaling.

Technology Stack

  • CRM: Dynamics 365 Sales Enterprise
  • Customization: JavaScript, C# Plugins
  • Integrations: airSlate, SharePoint, Confluence
  • Automation: Power Automate, Dataverse
  • Frameworks: Angular, .NET Core
  • Database: PostgreSQL
  • Hosting: AWS

A leading bus manufacturer faced inefficiencies in tender proposal management, relying on manual email monitoring, fragmented collaboration, and time-consuming document creation. The process led to delays, miscommunication, and lost opportunities. The client needed an automated, centralized system to streamline lead tracking, proposal development, and submission while improving collaboration across departments.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts implemented Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, integrated with Power Automate, JIRA, and Azure Functions, to automate workflows and improve process visibility.

  • Automated Lead Creation & Notification - Configured Power Automate to scan emails for tender inquiries and automatically create leads in Dynamics 365.
  • Lead Qualification & Opportunity Management - Enabled sales teams to qualify leads and convert them into opportunities with structured workflows.
  • Collaborative Opportunity Development with Teams & JIRA - Integrated Teams for auto-created opportunity channels and JIRA for task management, ensuring real-time collaboration.
  • Proposal Document Generation with Azure Functions - Automated proposal generation by extracting data from Dynamics 365 and formatting it into Word/PDF documents.
  • Proposal Submission & Email Automation - Integrated Outlook with Dynamics 365 for seamless proposal submission and automated tracking.
  • Opportunity Closure & Tracking - Enabled sales teams to track tender outcomes by marking opportunities as Closed-Won or Closed-Lost.

Technology Stack

  • CRM: Dynamics 365 Sales
  • Automation & Workflow: Power Automate
  • Collaboration & Task Management: Microsoft Teams, JIRA
  • Document Generation: Azure Functions
  • Email & Communication: Microsoft Outlook
  • Storage & Compliance: SharePoint

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A Restaurant Experience Management Suite required advanced dashboards to provide restaurant owners with actionable insights. The challenge was to enable informed decision-making and strategic operations across multi-brand, multi-location businesses.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts developed a scalable ETL framework on a semi-multi-tenant architecture to optimize reporting for multi-brand, multi-location restaurant chains. The solution provides a unified analytics interface, enhancing operational insights and revenue potential. Key features include:

  • ETL Layer: Built with Node.js to aggregate and unify data from diverse sources.
  • Optimized Data Structuring: Designed a Star Schema in MySQL for efficient data retrieval.
  • Dynamic Reporting: Leveraged Apex Charts for intuitive analytical dashboards.
  • Process Automation: Integrated Azure Web Jobs to streamline ETL workflows and monitor data transformation tasks.

Technology Stack

Angular, Node.js, MySQL (Star Schema), Apex Charts, AWS Ubuntu VM

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading brand protection company, renowned for its global domain registration services, sought to develop an agile search functionality to scan 250+ million domain records. The objective was to detect any newly registered or altered domain names that could pose risks or indicate fraudulent activities, thereby safeguarding their clients' digital assets.

Technology Solution

We developed a high-performance big data search engine capable of navigating over 250 million domain name records and delivering results in milliseconds. Key highlights include:

  • Nightly updates to maintain a comprehensive and current domain name dataset.
  • Optimized data storage for rapid search and access.
  • An API supporting 650 concurrent requests, each querying 500 domain names, with sub-second response times.
  • Hosted on Azure, leveraging Redis Re-Bloom for speed, reliability, and performance efficiency, with seamless deployment via Azure DevOps.

Technology Stack

Azure Pipeline, Azure DevOps, .NET Core, Cosmos DB, Azure Search Service, Azure Redis Cache, Azure SQL

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

A leading financial services provider faced operational inefficiencies and security concerns due to a decentralized API management approach. Complex endpoint structures, publicly accessible URLs, and limited scalability hampered their ability to integrate and manage APIs efficiently. The client needed a unified solution to simplify API integrations, enhance security, and prepare their architecture for future growth.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts implemented a centralized API management framework with AWS API Gateway to address these challenges.

Key Features:

  • Unified API Management: Centralized all API traffic across environments for improved manageability and streamlined operations.
  • URL Simplification: Implemented shorter, user-friendly URLs with Cloudflare to enhance developer productivity and simplify integrations.
  • Enhanced Security: Introduced API throttling and disabled direct backend access to safeguard the infrastructure.
  • Scalable Design: Future-proofed the architecture for seamless product integrations, including ATM APIs and other business services.
  • Optimized Routing: Utilized host header-based routing with AWS Load Balancer to ensure accurate request handling across environments.

Technology Stack

  • API Management: AWS API Gateway
  • Routing: AWS Load Balancer
  • DNS: Cloudflare
  • Documentation: OpenAPI Specification
  • Security: Throttling, host header-based routing

story.bodyHtml:
Business Problem

Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) poses a critical global health challenge. A global pharmaceutical leader sought a digital solution to raise AMR awareness, enhance adherence to best practices, and engage healthcare professionals in active learning through a captivating, educational platform.

Technology Solution

IncubXperts designed and developed a Progressive Web App (PWA) to meet the needs of healthcare professionals:

  • Seamless Accessibility: Built as a PWA, the app delivers a consistent experience across devices, including desktops and smartphones.
  • Immersive Educational Content: Features challenges like the "Handwash Challenge" and "Biomedical Waste Segregation," using quizzes, card swaps, drag-and-drop activities, and image-based queries to boost engagement.
  • Gamification Strategies: Incorporates scoring, leaderboards, badges, and point systems to foster a competitive, enjoyable learning environment.
  • Offline Sync Capability: Ensures uninterrupted access to resources in low-connectivity environments.
  • Practical Knowledge Assessment: Includes real-world challenges testing adherence to protocols and antimicrobial strategies, reinforcing learning and retention.

Technology Stack

  • Languages & Frameworks: .NET MVC, JavaScript
  • Database: SQL
  • Cloud Hosting: Azure
  • API Integration: Custom APIs for seamless backend operations
